chapters.title: Chapter 9 -9-Anti-Holy Grail of the Dark God
paragraphs: [Ding! You have slain the Gold-grade Boss Beast-Turned Father (LV45). Congratulations, you have reached Level 50!]
[Ding! Since you have reached the first advancement level cap of 50, you can no longer level up for now. Any overflow EXP has been stored in your EXP Pool!]
Obtained Items:
[Father’s Cross (Silver-grade)]
[Angel’s Blessing (Silver-grade)]
[Murky Crystal Fragment ×20]
[Gold Coin ×100]
[Contribution Points +300!]
[Ding! Congratulations, you are the first player to achieve a Boss First Clear. A server-wide announcement will now be made. Would you like to hide your information?]
Daniel raised an eyebrow, then chose without the slightest hesitation.
"No."
In his previous lives, he had deeply understood the saying:
"The tree that rises above the forest will be broken by the wind."
That was why he had always believed in keeping a low profile and developing quietly.
But now?
Heh.
If anyone dared come looking for trouble, Daniel would only praise their courage.
The next instant, a voice rang across the entirety of Stellar.
[Server-Wide Announcement!!!]
[Player "Faustus" of Universe No. 616 has become the first to slay the map Gold-grade Boss Beast-Turned Father, earning the achievement "Trailblazer"!]
[As the first player to kill a Gold-grade Boss, the following rewards have been granted:]
[Contribution Points +5000]
[Gold Coin +10000]
[Server-unique achievement unlocked: "Boss First Kill." Rewarded with the unique title "Trailblazer."]
[Attribute Points +50!]
[This achievement has been recorded in the Chronicles of Stellar and shall be remembered for all time!]
[World Channel]
"Holy shit?!?!?!!!"
"A Gold-grade Boss??? This is only the first day of launch!!!"
"A Level 45 Gold-grade monster—what the hell even is that??? WTF? I’m only Level 6. This guy has to be cheating, right?!"
"Faustus! I know him! He’s the one who sold that skill book earlier!"
"First-kill reward gives 50 attribute points? Damn, that’s like being five levels ahead of everyone else!"
"No, seriously, how can this game have a player this insane? Where are the GMs? Somebody come deal with this!"
"Damn it, what kind of idiot made this game? Somebody is blatantly cheating and nobody cares?!"
"Big bro, carry me! I can warm your bed..."
"Shut up, you zero, nobody asked—"
[Rhine Guild Main Channel]
At that moment, the channel was eerily quiet.
Chairman Prospector stared at the announcement, tapping his fingers lightly against the tabletop with a dull tap, tap, tap.
After a long pause, he finally spoke.
"Investigate."
"We already did," Vice Guild Leader North Wind replied immediately. "Faustus. Class: Archer. He previously listed an A-rank movement skill book on the market. One of our people bought it."
"An A-rank movement skill book?"
Prospector arched a brow. "Who has that skill book now?"
"I do," a player named Dragon Slayer said. "Haven’t learned it yet. I was planning to save it for one of our main assassins."
"Use it," Prospector said. "That kid definitely has something better."
"Chairman... your meaning is...?"
"Someone who can kill a Level 45 Gold-grade Boss on day one..." Prospector’s voice remained unreadable. "Either he found a bug in the game, or he’s a genuine god-tier player."
"No matter which it is—if we can recruit him, recruit him. If we can’t... then at the very least, don’t offend him."
He paused.
"Who contacted him earlier?"
"I did."
Guild Leader Rhine Watcher’s voice sounded a little weak. "But he blocked me."
The channel fell silent again.
"Forget it."
Prospector waved a hand. "If he doesn’t want to be disturbed, just put someone on him and keep watching. We’ll decide later."
Prospector’s gaze turned complicated.
As one of the people standing at the very top of Earth society, he knew many truths that ordinary people didn’t.
The things tied to this game...
Were far too enormous.
Daniel looked at the wall of system notifications in front of him, his grin stretching almost to his ears.
In his previous lives, he had seen server-wide announcements many times.
But this one felt especially satisfying.
Because this was the first Boss First Kill announcement he had ever claimed himself.
And back then, in order to compete with those powerful guilds and corporations for resources, he had often been forced to grow quietly and level in secrecy.
But now things were different.
While most players were still struggling below Level 10, he was already Level 50.
Even if those people harbored ill intentions, in the face of absolute strength, all they could do was back down.
As for reality...
Heh.
Unless he chose to expose himself, there was practically no way for anyone to trace him.
He opened his system panel.
[Trailblazer (Unique Title)]
Effect: Damage dealt to Gold-grade and above Bosses +10%, Critical Rate +5%!
Description: As the first warrior to slay a Gold-grade Boss, your name shall be engraved in the halls of Stellar.
Attribute Points: 50
Then he looked at the two pieces of equipment the boss had dropped.
Father’s Cross (Accessory): +20 Intelligence, +50% Mental Resistance, +100% MP Recovery Speed!
As for Angel’s Blessing, it was equipment for Mage- and Priest-type classes. The bonuses were decent, but unfortunately he had no use for it.
After equipping the cross, Daniel looked in satisfaction at his now massively inflated four core attributes:
Strength: 45
Intelligence: 65
Agility: 755
Constitution: 45
Even Daniel himself was stunned by the numbers before him.
This stat panel was already comparable to that of an average Level 70 player!
As for why he had dumped all his attribute points into Agility, it wasn’t only because he needed it for the Father fight.
It also had to do with something else coming up next.
And besides—even if attribute points were allocated incorrectly, once a player reached their second class advancement, the system granted one free full stat reset.
That was Stellar’s one and only chance for players to fix their mistakes.
Miss that opportunity, and any later stat respec would cost a truly astronomical price.
Very soon, Daniel suppressed his excitement and turned his attention back to the real matter at hand.
He took a deep breath and swept his gaze over the ruined church.
Behind the pulpit stood a statue.
It was three meters tall, entirely black, and depicted an utterly twisted existence.
It had countless tentacles, countless eyes, and a grotesquely distorted body.
The style of the statue was rough and eerie, like some product of primitive worship.
Most striking of all was the object placed at its chest—
An inverted cup.
A cup of dark violet-black, suspended upside down in a hollow at the center of the statue’s chest, surrounded by a faint black mist.
[Ding! Quest item discovered — Anti-Holy Grail of the Dark God (Damaged)]
Daniel understood at once.
This was the ultimate quest item of Adrian’s hidden questline.
In his previous life, even with all the resources he had accumulated and the advantage of future knowledge, he had paid an enormous price to obtain this final quest item.
And yet in this life...
He had done it on day one.
If this had been his former self, he wouldn’t have even dared dream of something like this.
He carefully walked toward the statue, his eyes fixed on the cup.
A thick black liquid kept seeping from the rim, flowing down the statue’s body and onto the floor, where it vanished without a trace.
That liquid—
Was the source of the infection.
He raised the Moon Reaper and aimed at the cup.
Whoosh!
The arrow shot out.
It struck the cup with perfect accuracy, and the explosion erupted instantly!
The statue shook violently.
Cracks spread outward from the point of impact.
The Anti-Holy Grail, having lost its support, tumbled free from the statue and rolled down.
At the same time, the statue itself began to collapse.
Huge black stone blocks rained down from the ceiling of the mine, and the entire church shook violently!
Daniel had no time to care about anything else. He hurriedly wrapped the cup in cloth and stuffed it into his inventory.
[Ding! Obtained quest item: Anti-Holy Grail of the Dark God (Damaged)]
When he turned back, the statue had completely shattered. Countless chunks of stone crashed down with thunderous force, and clouds of dust filled the entire church.
Daniel did not hesitate for even a moment.
He immediately used God Speed to escape the mine!

It had countless tentacles, countless eyes, and a grotesquely distorted body.
The style of the statue was rough and eerie, like some product of primitive worship.
Most striking of all was the object placed at its chest—
An inverted cup.
A cup of dark violet-black, suspended upside down in a hollow at the center of the statue’s chest, surrounded by a faint black mist.
[Ding!
Quest item discovered — Anti-Holy Grail of the Dark God (Damaged)]
Daniel understood at once.
This was the ultimate quest item of Adrian’s hidden questline.
In his previous life, even with all the resources he had accumulated and the advantage of future knowledge, he had paid an enormous price to obtain this final quest item.
And yet in this life...
He had done it on day one.
If this had been his former self, he wouldn’t have even dared dream of something like this.
He carefully walked toward the statue, his eyes fixed on the cup.
A thick black liquid kept seeping from the rim, flowing down the statue’s body and onto the floor, where it vanished without a trace.
That liquid—
Was the source of the infection.
He raised the Moon Reaper and aimed at the cup.
Whoosh!
The arrow shot out.
It struck the cup with perfect accuracy, and the explosion erupted instantly!
The statue shook violently.
Cracks spread outward from the point of impact.
The Anti-Holy Grail, having lost its support, tumbled free from the statue and rolled down.
At the same time, the statue itself began to collapse.
Huge black stone blocks rained down from the ceiling of the mine, and the entire church shook violently!
Daniel had no time to care about anything else.
He hurriedly wrapped the cup in cloth and stuffed it into his inventory.
[Ding!
Obtained quest item: Anti-Holy Grail of the Dark God (Damaged)]
When he turned back, the statue had completely shattered.
Countless chunks of stone crashed down with thunderous force, and clouds of dust filled the entire church.
Daniel did not hesitate for even a moment.
He immediately used God Speed to escape the mine!

chapters.title: Chapter 10 -10-Quest Settlement, Obtaining a Hidden Item
paragraphs: Back in Starter Village, beneath the blue locust tree, Adrian was still squatting there counting money.
A flash of white light suddenly appeared in the open space ahead, and a figure materialized out of nowhere, startling several players who had been running quests nearby.
Hearing the commotion, Adrian looked up—and his eyes instantly lit up.
"Oh? You’re back!"
"Judging by how dusty and battered you look, don’t tell me you got scared out of your wits?"
Daniel walked over to him.
"Scared? Hardly. My clothes are only a little dirty."
Before Adrian could question him, Daniel directly opened his inventory and started pulling out [Murky Crystal Fragments] one after another.
One piece. Two pieces... Twenty pieces. Thirty pieces...
Adrian’s eyes grew wider and wider.
By the time Daniel finished, there were over a hundred fragments piled in front of him, stacked into a small hill!
"Th-This..."
Adrian’s eyes were practically twitching. "Did you slaughter the entirety of Windmill Town or something?!"
Daniel clapped the dust off his hands. "Something like that."
[Ding! You have completed the quest far beyond requirements!]
[Reward bonus calculation in progress...]
[Gained EXP: +15,000 (Overflowed)]
[Gained Silver Coins: +200]
[Gained Contribution Points: +1000]
[Adrian Favorability increased to: Trust]
The way Adrian looked at Daniel changed completely.
The "easy mark" from before had turned into someone worthy of respect.
"My boy—no, my friend!"
"That kind of efficiency... I’ve got nothing to say!"
He rubbed his hands together, grinning as if he had just found money on the street.
"These are enough for seven or eight experiments! This time I’m definitely going to write an outstanding paper. The Main City Magic Academy will absolutely have to give me a bonus!"
He excitedly flipped through the fragments, then suddenly seemed to remember something and straightened up.
"By the way, since you went so deep into Windmill Town, did you discover the true source of the beastification? I suspect there’s something wrong deep in the mine..."
[Ding! Adrian entrusts you with further investigating the true source behind Windmill Town’s beastification. Accept?]
A smile curled at Daniel’s lips.
Instead of accepting the quest, he slowly pulled out a cloth bundle from his inventory.
"How about you take a look at this first?"
He lifted one corner of the cloth, revealing the violet-black body of a cup.
Adrian’s smile froze on his face.
The next second, he jumped up as if he had been struck by lightning.
"Th-This! This is!!!"
He reached out to grab it.
Daniel pulled his hand back. "Hey. You want it? Trade me something for it."
Adrian stomped his foot in frustration. "At least let me take a look! Let me confirm it first!"
"That’s not my problem. Show me the goods first."
Daniel leaned against the tree with the smug face of a shameless profiteer.
Adrian took several deep breaths, forcing himself to calm down.
He stared at Daniel for a few seconds, then suddenly laughed.
"You little brat... you really know how to do business."
He began rummaging through his belongings.
Very soon, he pulled out a set of silver-glowing leather armor.
"Archer Silvermoon Hunter Set, Silver-grade. More than enough for you..."
Daniel merely glanced at it.
A full Silver-grade set had originally been part of the final quest reward anyway. Who was he trying to fool?
He cut Adrian off directly.
"Take a look at what this is. Do you really think I care about Silver-grade gear?"
Adrian looked at the glowing Moon Reaper in Daniel’s hand and instantly choked on his words.
He couldn’t tell its exact tier, but at a minimum it had to be Gold-grade, and most likely Blackgold-grade or above.
Although he had no idea where Daniel had gotten it, he still gritted his teeth, stuffed the armor back, and dug around inside his robes for a long while.
Finally, with obvious reluctance, he took out two more items.
One was a Bronze-grade badge, with crossed swords engraved on the front.
The other was a pale golden card, covered in flowing arcane patterns.
[Apprentice Merit Medal]
Effect: All Attributes +20. With accumulated military merit, this medal allows you to exchange for rare mounts, skills, and equipment at the Quartermaster, and also claim a daily military stipend.
Description: Proof of an outstanding soldier, enough to grant you excellent待遇 and privileges.
[Single-Attribute Replication Badge (10/10)]
Effect: Upon use, raises one selected attribute to match your current highest attribute value for 24 hours. Remaining uses: 10.
Description: A miraculous alchemical creation that allows you to reach the extreme in one field.
Daniel’s pupils contracted slightly.
A medal granting +20 to all attributes was already precious enough.
But the Replication Badge was downright monstrous.
Right now, his Agility was 775.
If he used this badge on Strength, then for the next 24 hours his Strength would also become 775.
That meant temporarily gaining 700+ extra stat points out of nowhere!
But he didn’t rush to accept it. Instead, he carefully examined the item description.
Then suddenly, he noticed a line of tiny text.
[This item can be traded!]
Not bound?
Daniel’s heartbeat skipped for an instant.
That meant...
He suppressed the excitement in his chest and kept his face calm.
"Just these two? Are you trying to fob off a beggar?"
Adrian’s face turned green. "Do you even know how hard that medal is to get?"

"It has to be exchanged with military merit at the quartermaster! And that Replication Badge—do you have any idea how valuable it is? I barely managed to get hold of that one! I was saving it for myself!"
Daniel thought for a moment, then reluctantly handed over the cloth bundle.
"Fine. Deal."
Adrian snatched the grail at once and cradled it in both hands, examining it carefully.
Even his hands were trembling.
"So it really is... it really is it... the legendary Anti-Holy Grail!"
"The source of Windmill Town’s beastification! If I bring this back to the Academy, hahahaha..."
Adrian studied every detail of the Anti-Holy Grail with obsessive intensity, his breathing growing heavier and heavier.
Daniel paid him no attention.
[Ding! Detected quest item Anti-Holy Grail of the Dark God (Damaged) has been traded to the designated NPC. Millionfold Boost activated!]
[Enhancement Direction: Quality Boost!]
[Ding! Congratulations! Obtained: Anti-Holy Grail of the Dark God (Legendary-grade)]
Inside the system inventory, the damaged Anti-Holy Grail underwent a complete transformation!
Its body now flowed with a dark golden radiance.
The rim still faced downward, but no longer seeped black liquid.
Instead, it emanated a strange aura in which holiness and evil intertwined.
[Anti-Holy Grail of the Dark God]
Effect: Can be used to open a World-level Event or Instance.
Custom Permissions: Can define the instance name, background story, entry requirements, ticket price, monster distribution, special rules, and more.
Current Status: Not Activated.
Daniel’s eyes practically lit up.
A world-level instance!
"This is huge!"
Adrian finally looked up at Daniel again, his expression much more sincere than before.
"Brother, thanks!"
"If you come to the main city in the future, just head straight to the Military Magic Academy and find me. Whatever you need help with, just say the word."
[Ding! Adrian Favorability increased to: Close Friend!]
[Your Contribution Points with the Military Magic Academy have been unlocked. Initial Value: +500!]
Then Adrian no longer lingered. In the next instant, he disappeared from the spot.
Adrian was gone.
But Daniel didn’t hurry toward the main city just yet. He still had a few things to take care of.
Especially the new rewards he had just obtained.
After thinking for a moment, Daniel walked toward a wooden hut at the far end of the village.
Sitting at the entrance was an old man with white hair and beard, holding a wooden bow in his hand, squinting lazily under the sun.

chapters.title: Chapter 11 -11-Selling Quest Rewards, Triggering Millionfold Boost
paragraphs: [Old Hunter · Red]
Daniel stepped forward and struck up a conversation.
"Sir, I heard you’ve got some good stuff here?"
The old hunter raised his eyes to look at him, and a sharp glint flashed through those cloudy pupils.
"Oh? A little guy at Level 50?"
"Not bad. What do you want to buy?"
A shop list popped up: all kinds of ordinary arrows, low-tier traps, and several dusty beginner skill books for Archers and Hunters.
Daniel’s gaze immediately locked onto one particular skill book.
[Scattershot (D-rank)]
Effect: Fires 3 arrows at once in a fan-shaped area ahead. Each arrow deals 60% damage.
Cooldown: 10 seconds.
Price: 400 Silver Coins.
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
A D-rank AoE skill!
Even if it only fired three arrows, paired with the explosive effect of his arrows, it would massively improve his mob-clearing efficiency.
Of course, that wasn’t the real reason he had come here to buy a skill book.
The true key was—
This skill book was tradable.
There was an Archer instructor in the center of the village, sure, but the skills you learned there were not only the lowest-tier ones—they were also untradable.
[Silver Coins -400]
After getting what he wanted, Daniel turned and walked toward the general store at the village entrance, where old merchant Grey was still dozing off.
"Boss, do you buy skill books?"
Grey opened his eyes. A trace of surprise appeared in his expression when he saw Daniel, clearly recognizing this particularly bizarre newbie.
"Of course."
Daniel slapped [Scattershot] onto the counter.
"Sold."
Grey took the book and handed him 40 Silver Coins.
"Tsk tsk, this is a truly rare skill book. I’m taking a loss here—giving you a little extra money for it!"
Seeing the old man’s expression of you’ve made a huge profit, Daniel couldn’t help rolling his eyes.
[Ding! Sold item: Scattershot (D-rank), sale price: 40 Silver Coins. Millionfold Boost activated!]
[Obtained Gold Coins: 400,000!]
[Sold item is a skill book. Player selected Quality Boost!]
[Congratulations! Obtained skill book: Arrowstorm (SSS-rank)]
A golden, radiant skill book appeared in his inventory.
[Arrowstorm (SSS-rank)]

Effect: Fires a massive rain of arrows over a designated area, covering a range of 50 × 50 meters. Each arrow deals 300% damage and carries a piercing effect. The number of arrows depends on Agility: every 100 Agility grants 100 additional arrows, up to a maximum of 10,000 arrows.
Cooldown: 30 seconds.
MP Cost: 500.
Daniel sucked in a breath.
A fifty-meter area.
A thousand arrows.
Each arrow dealing 300% damage.
And with piercing?
This was basically carpet bombing!
He learned it immediately, and soon another golden icon appeared in his skill bar.
Now he had:
a single-target burst skill enhanced by clones,
an AoE battlefield-clearing skill,
and a movement skill for survival.
At this point, he was practically all-rounded.
But he still wasn’t done.
Daniel slapped the [Single-Attribute Replication Badge] onto the counter next.
"This one. Name a price."
Grey took it and looked it over, one eyebrow rising.
"Oh? Something that replicates an attribute?"
"It can only be used ten times, but the effect’s not bad. I’ll give you 1 Silver Coin."
Daniel’s mouth twitched.
This was the item Adrian had been saving as a trump card for survival. Its value didn’t even need explaining.
Which just went to show how viciously this old man loved to lowball.
But then again, there was only one merchant in all of Starter Village.
Besides, with Millionfold Boost, Daniel wasn’t exactly short on money anymore.
"Sold."
Old Grey shot him a surprised glance, then handed him a single Silver Coin.
[Ding! Detected sold item: Single-Attribute Replication Badge (10/10), sale price: 1 Silver Coin. Millionfold Boost activated!]
[Obtained Gold Coins: 10,000!]
[Sold item is a special consumable. Host selected Quality Boost!]
[Generating returned item...]
[Congratulations, player has obtained: Heart of Balance (Permanent)]
A pale golden badge appeared in his inventory, completely different from the previous one.
Its entire body was crystalline, like a perfectly cut gemstone, with seven-colored radiance slowly flowing inside it.
Daniel took a deep breath and opened its details.
[Heart of Balance (Accessory)]
Type: Special Item (Consumed upon use, cannot be dropped)
Effect: After use, permanently raises all four core attributes to match the player’s current highest attribute.
Description: The pinnacle masterpiece of alchemy, breaking the taboo that attributes can never truly be balanced. Only those who dare to let go can obtain true balance.
Current Highest Attribute: Agility — 775
Daniel’s hand trembled slightly.
All attributes raised to the highest one!?
That meant his current Strength 45, Intelligence 65, and Constitution 45 would all...
He didn’t hesitate.
He clicked Use immediately.
[Ding! You have used "Heart of Balance"! ]
[Recalculating attributes...]
[Strength: 65 → 775]
[Intelligence: 85 → 775]
[Agility: 775 → 775 (unchanged)]
[Constitution: 65 → 775]
[Attribute adjustment complete!]
A pale golden glow burst out from Daniel’s body, then instantly withdrew back into him.
He opened his panel and checked the detailed status.
[Player: Faustus]
[Level: 50 (EXP Pool Overflow)]
[Strength: 775]
[Intelligence: 775]
[Agility: 775]
[Constitution: 775]
[Attribute Points: 0]
[Title: Trailblazer (Unique)]
[Equipment: Moon Reaper (Legendary-grade), Father’s Cross (Silver-grade), Apprentice Merit Medal]
Daniel stared blankly at the panel in front of him and fell silent for a full five seconds.
775 points in all four attributes?
What did that mean?
It meant his HP was now 775 × 50 = 38,750 HP—more than ten times what it had been before!
It meant his MP was enough to cast dozens of rounds of clones!
It meant his Attack Power...
With Strength 775, and Moon Reaper granting 10 extra Attack Power per point of Strength, that alone meant 7,750 Attack Power just from Strength, before even counting the base attack...
He could casually one-shot a normal Level 50 monster with a random arrow now!
And the most terrifying part was—
All of his attributes were now balanced.
He had no weakness.
He was no longer a fragile Archer.
He was now a monster with huge HP, blazing speed, and massive MP reserves—
A true hexagon warrior.
And on top of that, this still wasn’t even his limit.
He hadn’t forgotten that some of his attribute points had originally been spread among the other stats.
Once he reached his second class advancement and reset all his points back into Agility...
He clicked his tongue.
At Level 50, he would have the four-dimensional stat panel of a player over Level 100.
Daniel clenched his fist, feeling the surge of power flowing through his body.
Before, when fighting bosses, he had needed to rely on movement, kiting, and God Speed just to survive.
Now?
He felt like he could stand there and trade blows with a boss head-on.
Not that there was any need for that—
But the confidence was there.
"Alright."
He closed the panel, forcing down the excitement in his chest.
Then Daniel opened his inventory and looked at the complete Anti-Holy Grail, anticipation welling up inside him.
It was time...
To make something big happen.

[Intelligence: 85 → 775]
[Agility: 775 → 775 (unchanged)]
[Constitution: 65 → 775]
[Attribute adjustment complete!]
A pale golden glow burst out from Daniel’s body, then instantly withdrew back into him.
He opened his panel and checked the detailed status.
[Player: Faustus]
[Level: 50 (EXP Pool Overflow)]
[Strength: 775]
[Intelligence: 775]
[Agility: 775]
[Constitution: 775]
[Attribute Points: 0]
[Title: Trailblazer (Unique)]
[Equipment: Moon Reaper (Legendary-grade), Father’s Cross (Silver-grade), Apprentice Merit Medal]
Daniel stared blankly at the panel in front of him and fell silent for a full five seconds.
775 points in all four attributes?
What did that mean?
It meant his HP was now 775 × 50 = 38,750 HP—more than ten times what it had been before!
It meant his MP was enough to cast dozens of rounds of clones!
It meant his Attack Power...
With Strength 775, and Moon Reaper granting 10 extra Attack Power per point of Strength, that alone meant 7,750 Attack Power just from Strength, before even counting the base attack...
He could casually one-shot a normal Level 50 monster with a random arrow now!
And the most terrifying part was—
All of his attributes were now balanced.
He had no weakness.
He was no longer a fragile Archer.
He was now a monster with huge HP, blazing speed, and massive MP reserves—
A true hexagon warrior.
And on top of that, this still wasn’t even his limit.
He hadn’t forgotten that some of his attribute points had originally been spread among the other stats.
Once he reached his second class advancement and reset all his points back into Agility...
He clicked his tongue.
At Level 50, he would have the four-dimensional stat panel of a player over Level 100.
Daniel clenched his fist, feeling the surge of power flowing through his body.
Before, when fighting bosses, he had needed to rely on movement, kiting, and God Speed just to survive.
Now?
He felt like he could stand there and trade blows with a boss head-on.
Not that there was any need for that—
But the confidence was there.
"Alright."
He closed the panel, forcing down the excitement in his chest.
Then Daniel opened his inventory and looked at the complete Anti-Holy Grail, anticipation welling up inside him.
It was time...
To make something big happen.

chapters.title: Chapter 12 -12-World-Wide Announcement — Battle for the Starter Village
paragraphs: Daniel clicked on the Anti-Holy Grail and selected [Open World Event].
[Please set event parameters:]
Event Name: [Beast Tide Is Coming]
Background Story: (Default) The curse of an ancient Evil God has triggered a monster uprising, laying siege to the Starter Village.
Participation Range: All players of Universe No. 616 (Level 1 and above)
Entry Requirement: None (Ticket price can be set)
Ticket Price: 1 Copper Coin (Customizable)
Monster Settings: Auto-generated (Type, quantity, level, grade, and drops cannot be modified)
Daniel thought for a moment, then entered 1 Copper Coin as the ticket price.
[Warning: All ticket revenue will belong to you. Confirm?]
Confirm!
To be honest, the old Daniel would have spent ages calculating how to squeeze out even one extra Gold Coin.
But right now?
He wanted to properly experience what life as a filthy rich tycoon felt like.
[Opening event...]
[Sending invitations to the entire server...]
The next second, a blood-red server-wide announcement exploded across Stellar.
[Emergency Server-Wide Announcement!!!]
[Player "Faustus" has triggered a World-level Event — Beast Tide Is Coming!]

[Event Description: The sleeping will of an Evil God has awakened, driving countless magical beasts to lay siege to Starter Village No. 616. All players may participate in the defense. Repelling the beast tide will grant generous rewards!]
[Participation Method: Pay an entry fee of 1 Copper Coin to enter the event instance. (Death Penalty: -10% EXP at current level; monster drops are automatically looted)]
[Event Start Time: 30 minutes from now]
[Registration Deadline: Before the event begins]
Almost the instant the announcement went out, the entire World Channel exploded.
"What the hell!? A World-level Event? On day one?!"
"Seriously, I haven’t even left Starter Village yet and there’s already an event? There wasn’t even any preview!"
"Faustus again? He triggered this too? Come on, this guy has to be a GM, right?!"
"1 Copper Coin for entry? That cheap? Can some kind soul donate me 1 Copper Coin...!"
"WTF, I’m still out in the wilderness—running back to town right now!"
"Party up, party up! Anyone grouping?"
"Big bro, carry me..."
Daniel watched the World Channel scroll madly and the corners of his mouth lifted.
Thirty minutes from now, his inventory would be filled with a ridiculous number of Copper Coins—
And then Millionfold Boost would trigger.
He opened the Event Management Interface of the Anti-Holy Grail and began adjusting the details of the instance.
Instance Name: [Battle for the Starter Village]

Background Story: The Anti-Holy Grail left behind by the Evil God has awakened, drawing countless magical beasts into a frenzied assault on the human Starter Village. All players must unite and defend the final line of resistance.
Death Penalty: -10% EXP at current level
Drop Rules: All monster drops are auto-looted directly into each player’s inventory

Point Rules: Points are calculated according to the quantity and quality of monsters killed. After the event ends, extra rewards may be exchanged (automatically distributed by the system, not through "Faustus")
Settings complete!
Soon enough, the thirty minutes passed in a flash.
The plaza of Starter Village was packed with players as dense as ants—at the very least, tens of thousands of them.
Everyone had their heads tilted up, staring toward the distant mountains, where a gigantic blood-red portal was slowly taking shape.
[Ding! World Event Beast Tide Is Coming has opened. Enter?]
One player took the lead and rushed in. The others quickly followed.
Daniel, however, did not hurry.
He stood beneath the old blue locust tree at the village entrance, watching as the players swarmed into the portal.
Meanwhile, the number of Copper Coins in his inventory was skyrocketing.
In just a few short minutes, the number of registrants broke 50,000, and it was still climbing.
[Total Ticket Revenue: 87,324 Copper Coins]
[Millionfold Boost triggered... Obtained Gold Coins: 8,732,400,000!]
8.7324 billion Gold Coins deposited instantly.
"How boringly easy~"
Daniel closed the system notification, took a deep breath, and stepped into the portal.
His vision blurred.
The next moment, he found himself standing in the plaza of Starter Village.
But this was no longer the lively little village from before.
The sky was a deep blood-red.
The surrounding houses had all their doors and windows tightly shut.
And on the distant horizon, a black tide of monsters was surging forward like a living flood.
[Event Officially Begins! First Wave: Ordinary Monster Tide]
[Monster Types: Mutated Wild Wolves, Frenzied Boars, Venomous Spiders...]
[Level Range: 10–20]
[Quantity: 50,000]
Before the players could even fully react, the monsters had already reached the village entrance.
"WTF! That many?!"
"You’ve got to be kidding me—the weakest ones are Level 10?!"
Some time had already passed since launch, so most players were now above Level 10, and a very small handful had even reached Level 20 and completed their first class advancement.
But even so, when faced with a monster tide numbering in the tens of thousands for the first time, most of them still couldn’t help but panic.
Though more than panic—
What filled them most was excitement.
After all, they wouldn’t really die.
One by one, players roared excitedly and charged straight into the monster horde with their weapons raised.
"Go go go!"
"Mages and Archers, AoE! Priests keep the heals up! Summoners and Warriors, hold the line!"
In an instant, total chaos erupted.
"Are you all cowards or what?! That blood wolf was one hit from death and none of you dared finish it!"
"You bitch, explain to me why it’s suddenly at full HP then?!"
One player charged in enthusiastically—
Only to be slapped to death by that blood wolf with a single claw strike.
"Uh... the wolf that killed me already got trampled to death..."
"Fuck you..."
Daniel stood in the middle of the plaza and did not hurry to act.
He swept his eyes across the battlefield and found that most players were only a little above Level 10.
The vast majority were clearly fighting these Level 10+ monster tides for the first time and were getting beaten into complete disorder.
Some had already started being forcibly teleported out of the instance.
But Daniel also noticed that some guild players, thanks to their coordination, had already begun to stabilize their lines.
Especially the larger guilds like Rhine Guild.
Those players had rich gaming experience and strong fundamentals to begin with, and after just one day inside Stellar, they had already built up solid teamwork.
More than twenty core members formed a battle formation, holding an area so tightly that not even water could leak through.
Similar formations gradually began taking shape across the battlefield, slowly stabilizing the front.
Daniel smiled faintly.
Finally, he moved.
He raised the Moon Reaper and aimed at the densest area of monsters.
Arrowstorm!
Whoooosh—
Under the astonished gazes of all the players, the sky suddenly darkened, and a fierce wind swept through the battlefield.
"Huh? It can rain inside an instance?"
"No, wait, there wasn’t even a single cloud just now. That makes no sense, does it?!"
Before anyone could react—
The next instant, countless raindrop-like streaks fell from the sky, pouring into the monster tide.
Boom!
Boom boom boom boom—!
A continuous chain of explosions thundered across the battlefield. Flames shot into the air. Smoke and dust rolled everywhere.
When the smoke finally cleared, everyone focused their eyes and saw it clearly—
Within a 50-meter radius, several hundred monsters had all been blasted into pieces, leaving behind a ground full of crater-like impact pits.
The entire world went silent for one second.
Then the players lost their minds.
"What the hell??!!"
"What was that in the sky?! Arrows?!!"
"You’ve got to be kidding me—one skill just one-shot hundreds of monsters?!"
"Could that be some kind of Starter Village protection mechanism?"
"Fuck, what did I just see?!"
Daniel ignored their cries of shock and drew his bow again.
In the blink of an eye, wind and clouds gathered once more, and several more waves of arrow rain crashed down.
Before the first wave of monsters had even reached the village entrance, most of them were already dead.
The few survivors that slipped through were instantly mobbed and finished off by the other players, letting plenty of them level up on the spot.
But after that display, everyone’s attention turned toward the glowing figure standing atop the blue locust tree.
"WTF?! A Level 50 Archer—Faustus?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 13 -13-Instantly Killing a Gold-Grade Boss
paragraphs: "What? So this is Faustus, the guy who’s been making all that noise lately? Wait, what did you say—Level 50?!"
"WTF? Where are the GMs? Are they blind? This guy is blatantly cheating!"
"You’ve got to be kidding me. I’ve been grinding nonstop since going online, and I’m only Level 19. How the hell is he already Level 50?"
"No, seriously, why are these mobs getting one-shot the moment they touch his hands?"
"Are you even going to let us play? At least leave some scraps for the rest of us!"
Ignoring the explosive reactions from the crowd of players, Daniel simply continued clearing the monsters in front of him as if nothing had happened.
With his overwhelming intervention, every monster in sight was wiped out in less than five minutes.
[Ding! Attention all players within the map: The second wave of elite-grade monster tide is about to arrive!]
[Monster Types: Mutated Wolf King, Frenzied Boar King, Venom Spider Queen...]
[Level Range: 20–30 (elite-grade)]
[Quantity: 5,000]
Elite-grade monsters were far stronger than normal mobs. A Level 30 Wolf King could one-shot low-level players with a single charge.
But Daniel still stood at the very front, releasing volleys of arrows with an expressionless face.
This time, he used his clones.
Ten clones appeared at the same time. Together with his main body, eleven overlapping waves of Arrow Rain crashed into the monster horde simultaneously.
The scene was downright apocalyptic.
Explosions filled the area for a thousand meters in every direction, and even the ground was blasted nearly ten meters deep.
Elite-grade monsters?
They were still getting one-shot.
"What... what does this even mean?"
The players participating in the event stared with wide eyes.
When they saw the notice for the second wave of elite-grade monsters, they had all been worried about whether they could even survive it.
But the instant the monsters spawned, before they could even see what they looked like, a storm of "bombs" had already flown over and erased them all!?
"You’ve got to be kidding me. He’s even bringing hacks into this game?"
"Holy crap! He’s doing it this openly? Rigged! This game is rigged! I can’t play this at all!"
"If the GMs still don’t ban him, I’m quitting!"
"Oh? And who exactly do you think you are? You think the GMs are begging you to stay?"
"...Are we even playing the same game?"
At that moment, countless players fell into a mix of shock, numbness, and anger.
But the truly sharp players had already rushed forward to finish off the monsters that still had a sliver of HP left.
What a joke.
These were Level 20–30 elite-grade monsters. At their current levels, unless they teamed up, fighting them was practically suicide.
As for resisting this elite-grade invasion, sure, they could theoretically brute-force it with numbers—but if too many people died, the EXP loss would be painful.
And besides, the more people there were, the less meat everyone got.

Right now, the monsters had already been blown into near-death. With a bit of luck, one touch would be enough to steal the kill. And that was personal EXP all to themselves—an opportunity this huge was something you could fight over and still fail to get.
Daniel took in everyone’s reactions, but he didn’t stop the players who rushed in to harvest the low-HP monsters.
He had already eaten the meat.
Naturally, he had to leave some soup for everyone else.
While most players were still busy complaining, the third wave of the beast tide had already arrived in silence.
[Monster Types: Mixed wave of flying monsters + ground monsters]
[Level Range: 30–35 (elite-grade)]
[Quantity: 2,000]
Not to mention that they were all elite-grade and even higher level—just the flying monsters alone were enough to leave many melee players helpless.
Daniel glanced up.
In the next instant, he activated God Speed and flashed straight into the sky, continuously unleashing Arrow Rain in midair.
His arrows blanketed the heavens, and the roar of explosions shook the clouds.
The flying monsters fell from the sky like a hailstorm.
When the players saw that scene, they had gone completely numb inside.
"What the hell... is he even human?"
"I’m seriously starting to suspect he’s a plant from the game company. It’s a new game, so having a shill isn’t weird."
"What kind of shill pulls dozens of levels ahead of second place? The player in second place just hit Level 25!"
"This is absurd. So we’re just here to be spectators?"
"Are you stupid? Everyone else already rushed in to last-hit the low-HP mobs, and only an idiot like you is still standing back here questioning things!"
"...No, I’m a priest."
Right then—
A cold and urgent system notification suddenly rang out.
[Warning! Warning! Warning!]
[The final BOSS of this beast tide event is about to arrive. All players, please prepare yourselves!]
Before the players could even react—
Crack!
A gash suddenly tore open in the dark-red sky.
The next moment, a gigantic shadow dropped violently from the rift and smashed straight into the ground outside the village entrance, making the entire Starter Village tremble without end.
Boom!
Rumble—!
As the dust settled and everyone focused their eyes, they saw a colossal beast over twenty meters tall.
Its body was covered in pitch-black scales. Three pairs of wings spread across its back, and a spiral horn atop its head crackled with lightning.
[Thunderwing Dragon · LV45 (blackgold-grade BOSS)]
The players all sucked in a sharp breath.
A blackgold-grade boss!
The strongest monsters they had encountered so far were only silver-grade monsters—and even those were beyond them.
A Level 45 blackgold-grade boss, under normal circumstances, would require at least several hundred players of the same level raiding together to take down.
But the moment Daniel saw the massive creature, he couldn’t help licking his lips.
His four core attributes had already reached outrageous levels, pushing his combat power to an absurd height. He still hadn’t tested what it felt like to go all out.
In the next instant, ten clones appeared behind him.
Eleven bows aimed at the Thunderwing Dragon at the same time.
The Thunderwing Dragon seemed to sense that it had been locked on by Daniel’s skill, and it let out a furious roar toward the sky.
With a single flap of its wings, endless bolts of lightning rained down from above!
Boom boom boom—!
Countless players were caught in the crossfire and blasted into ashes while still wearing blank expressions.
Daniel used God Speed in rapid succession, his figure flickering back and forth through the storm of lightning.
At the same time, eleven volleys of Arrow Rain poured down.
Boom!
Boom boom boom—!
The explosions instantly swallowed the Thunderwing Dragon. Although it dodged nearly half of the attacks in the first moment, its HP still dropped by 30% in an instant!
"Oh? Pretty tough, huh?"
The Thunderwing Dragon was enraged. It spat out a massive pillar of lightning that swept across the battlefield.
Daniel dodged immediately, emerging without a scratch.
Seeing this, the Thunderwing Dragon tore through the clouds high above, preparing to dive straight down in an attack.
But at the very same moment, Daniel activated God Speed as well, instantly chasing up into the sky and confronting the Thunderwing Dragon face-to-face.

The Thunderwing Dragon, seeing this tiny human daring to oppose it head-on, went completely berserk. Lightning surged across its entire body, while a black-and-blue sphere of energy rapidly gathered in its maw.
Daniel’s pupils contracted. Instantly, he activated God Speed at maximum range and flashed a thousand meters away.
BOOM!!!
A black-and-blue beam slammed into the ground.
The power of the Thunderwing Dragon’s breath instantly flattened everything within several hundred meters. Countless players who failed to dodge in time were directly vaporized.
But Daniel remained completely unharmed.
As soon as the explosion ended, he flashed back once more.
This time, he had no intention of holding back.
He drew his bow and fired one final arrow at the enraged Thunderwing Dragon.
The arrow pierced straight through the Thunderwing Dragon’s skull, and the explosion instantly wiped out its remaining 70% HP!
[Ding! You have killed Thunderwing Dragon · LV45 (blackgold-grade BOSS)]
[Obtained items: Thunderwing Dragon Wings (platinum-grade), Thunder Dragon Core ×1 (blackgold-grade), Death Curse Potion ×10, 500 gold coins...]
The giant corpse fell from the sky and crashed heavily into the ground, smashing out a massive crater.
The entire instance fell deathly silent.
All the players raised their heads and stared at the figure in the sky holding a silver bow.
Only after a long while did someone on the World Channel tremblingly type out a single line:
"I was wrong. He’s not a GM... he’s a god!"
[Ding! The BOSS has been slain!]
[World-level Event ended early. Calculating points...]
System notifications rang out beside the ears of countless players.
But by then, most of them were already too stunned to react.
Daniel landed at the village entrance and looked at the battlefield, now left in complete ruin. A smile curled at the corners of his lips.
After this, the entire Stellar would probably remember the name "Faustus."

These were Level 20–30 elite-grade monsters.
At their current levels, unless they teamed up, fighting them was practically suicide.
As for resisting this elite-grade invasion, sure, they could theoretically brute-force it with numbers—but if too many people died, the EXP loss would be painful.
And besides, the more people there were, the less meat everyone got.
Right now, the monsters had already been blown into near-death.
With a bit of luck, one touch would be enough to steal the kill.
And that was personal EXP all to themselves—an opportunity this huge was something you could fight over and still fail to get.
Daniel took in everyone’s reactions, but he didn’t stop the players who rushed in to harvest the low-HP monsters.
He had already eaten the meat.
Naturally, he had to leave some soup for everyone else.
While most players were still busy complaining, the third wave of the beast tide had already arrived in silence.
[Monster Types: Mixed wave of flying monsters + ground monsters]
[Level Range: 30–35 (elite-grade)]
[Quantity: 2,000]
Not to mention that they were all elite-grade and even higher level—just the flying monsters alone were enough to leave many melee players helpless.
Daniel glanced up.
In the next instant, he activated God Speed and flashed straight into the sky, continuously unleashing Arrow Rain in midair.
His arrows blanketed the heavens, and the roar of explosions shook the clouds.
The flying monsters fell from the sky like a hailstorm.
When the players saw that scene, they had gone completely numb inside.
"What the hell... is he even human?"
"I’m seriously starting to suspect he’s a plant from the game company.
It’s a new game, so having a shill isn’t weird."
"What kind of shill pulls dozens of levels ahead of second place?
The player in second place just hit Level 25!"
"This is absurd.
So we’re just here to be spectators?"
"Are you stupid?
Everyone else already rushed in to last-hit the low-HP mobs, and only an idiot like you is still standing back here questioning things!"
"...No, I’m a priest."
Right then—
A cold and urgent system notification suddenly rang out.
[Warning!
Warning!
Warning!]
[The final BOSS of this beast tide event is about to arrive.
All players, please prepare yourselves!]
Before the players could even react—
Crack!
A gash suddenly tore open in the dark-red sky.
The next moment, a gigantic shadow dropped violently from the rift and smashed straight into the ground outside the village entrance, making the entire Starter Village tremble without end.
Boom!
Rumble—!
As the dust settled and everyone focused their eyes, they saw a colossal beast over twenty meters tall.
Its body was covered in pitch-black scales.
Three pairs of wings spread across its back, and a spiral horn atop its head crackled with lightning.
[Thunderwing Dragon · LV45 (blackgold-grade BOSS)]
The players all sucked in a sharp breath.
A blackgold-grade boss!
The strongest monsters they had encountered so far were only silver-grade monsters—and even those were beyond them.
A Level 45 blackgold-grade boss, under normal circumstances, would require at least several hundred players of the same level raiding together to take down.
But the moment Daniel saw the massive creature, he couldn’t help licking his lips.
His four core attributes had already reached outrageous levels, pushing his combat power to an absurd height.
He still hadn’t tested what it felt like to go all out.
In the next instant, ten clones appeared behind him.
Eleven bows aimed at the Thunderwing Dragon at the same time.
The Thunderwing Dragon seemed to sense that it had been locked on by Daniel’s skill, and it let out a furious roar toward the sky.
With a single flap of its wings, endless bolts of lightning rained down from above!
Boom boom boom—!
Countless players were caught in the crossfire and blasted into ashes while still wearing blank expressions.
Daniel used God Speed in rapid succession, his figure flickering back and forth through the storm of lightning.
At the same time, eleven volleys of Arrow Rain poured down.
Boom!
Boom boom boom—!
The explosions instantly swallowed the Thunderwing Dragon.
Although it dodged nearly half of the attacks in the first moment, its HP still dropped by 30% in an instant!
"Oh?
Pretty tough, huh?"
The Thunderwing Dragon was enraged.
It spat out a massive pillar of lightning that swept across the battlefield.
Daniel dodged immediately, emerging without a scratch.
Seeing this, the Thunderwing Dragon tore through the clouds high above, preparing to dive straight down in an attack.
But at the very same moment, Daniel activated God Speed as well, instantly chasing up into the sky and confronting the Thunderwing Dragon face-to-face.
The Thunderwing Dragon, seeing this tiny human daring to oppose it head-on, went completely berserk.
Lightning surged across its entire body, while a black-and-blue sphere of energy rapidly gathered in its maw.
Daniel’s pupils contracted.
Instantly, he activated God Speed at maximum range and flashed a thousand meters away.
BOOM!!!
A black-and-blue beam slammed into the ground.
The power of the Thunderwing Dragon’s breath instantly flattened everything within several hundred meters.
Countless players who failed to dodge in time were directly vaporized.
But Daniel remained completely unharmed.
As soon as the explosion ended, he flashed back once more.
This time, he had no intention of holding back.
He drew his bow and fired one final arrow at the enraged Thunderwing Dragon.
The arrow pierced straight through the Thunderwing Dragon’s skull, and the explosion instantly wiped out its remaining 70% HP!
[Ding!
You have killed Thunderwing Dragon · LV45 (blackgold-grade BOSS)]
[Obtained items: Thunderwing Dragon Wings (platinum-grade), Thunder Dragon Core ×1 (blackgold-grade), Death Curse Potion ×10, 500 gold coins...]
The giant corpse fell from the sky and crashed heavily into the ground, smashing out a massive crater.
The entire instance fell deathly silent.
All the players raised their heads and stared at the figure in the sky holding a silver bow.
Only after a long while did someone on the World Channel tremblingly type out a single line:
"I was wrong.
He’s not a GM... he’s a god!"
[Ding!
The BOSS has been slain!]
[World-level Event ended early.
Calculating points...]
System notifications rang out beside the ears of countless players.
But by then, most of them were already too stunned to react.
Daniel landed at the village entrance and looked at the battlefield, now left in complete ruin.
A smile curled at the corners of his lips.
After this, the entire Stellar would probably remember the name "Faustus."

chapters.title: Chapter 14 -14-Server-Wide Fire Sale — Two Legendary-Grade Pieces of Equipment Secured!
paragraphs: [Server Announcement: The Beast Tide Is Coming event has ended!]
[Calculating player points...]
[Contribution Rankings]
[No. 1: Faustus — Kills: 38,742 (including BOSS ×1, elite-grade ×6,156), Points: 9,999,999...]
[No. 2: Rhine·Dragon Slayer — Kills: 156, Points: 12,450]
[No. 3: Blade of Dusk — Kills: 132, Points: 10,870]
The World Channel completely exploded.
"Am I blind? How many 9s are there behind first place?"
"What the hell does this mean? Faustus killed over thirty thousand monsters by himself???"
"Stop joking. There were that many players registered, and their combined kills still don’t add up to a fraction of his..."
"So this is what a real top-tier player looks like? I need to verify my account..."
"My mom asked me why I’m kneeling while gaming..."
"The second-place player only killed 156? No, seriously, what exactly happened inside that event world? Can someone explain?!"
"Transfer me 50 dollars and I’ll give you firsthand intel from the scene. Guaranteed explosive!"
"I still think this game has hacks..."
"Faustus be like: Turns out I worried for nothing. So you were all just competing for second place?"
"Please, have some humanity!"
Daniel stood atop the ruins of Starter Village, surrounded by the gradually fading light curtain of the instance.
Players were being teleported out one after another, each of them dusty and bedraggled, yet excitement still shone across their faces.
Even though most of them had barely managed to touch a monster, the event rewards were genuinely generous.
Anyone who had provided real assistance would receive, at minimum, a bronze-grade piece of equipment and an experience bonus.
Daniel also opened his own event reward panel.
[Event Ranking: No. 1]
[Base Rewards: gold coin ×5000, Contribution Points ×2000, Exp pool +5,000,000]
[Rewards: deathcurse potion ×10, blackgold-grade Treasure Chest ×1]
[Congratulations! You received an SSS Rating. Additional Rewards: Blessed Grail (platinum-grade), Demon Mask (platinum-grade)]
Daniel’s eyes lit up instantly.
Every single one of them was good stuff!
He first checked the reward for killing the BOSS.
[Wing of Thunder (platinum-grade)]
Agility: +20
Strength: +20
Effect 1 — Wings of Lightning: Grants the ability to fly after activation. Flight speed +300% for 30 minutes. Cooldown: 1 hour.
Effect 2 — Lightning Radiance Protection
Effect 3 — Lightning Affinity
Equipment Requirement: Constitution above 100.
Description: An item forged with the Thunderwing Dragon’s wings as its core, preserving part of the lightning power it wielded in life.
Daniel’s eyes brightened.
A flying item!
In the world of Stellar, being able to fly and being unable to fly were practically two different games.
Many terrains could only be reached through flight, and many BOSSes only revealed their weak points while airborne.
And a 300% flight speed bonus meant crossing huge stretches of land in a very short amount of time.
This was an incredibly practical piece of equipment. Still, Daniel already had God Speed, so the item itself wasn’t particularly attractive to him.
The only thing he currently lacked was the ability to fly.
He then looked at the second item.
[Thunderwing Dragon Core (blackgold-grade)]
Type: Forging / Alchemy Material
Effect: A core containing all the essence of the Thunderwing Dragon. Can be used for forging, alchemy, enchanting, pet feeding, and more.
Description: The Thunderwing Dragon’s entire Strength is condensed within it.
Daniel stared at the purple crystal core, streaked with flickering lightning, and fell into thought.
A blackgold-grade material!
It was obviously an extremely rare item. Though it couldn’t be used directly, whether for forging weapons or alchemy, it could definitely produce top-tier results.
On top of that, he had killed more than thirty thousand monsters during the event, and every dropped piece of equipment had gone straight into his inventory.
The overwhelming majority were bronze-grade and iron-grade items, with even a small number of silver-grade pieces mixed in!
Without much hesitation, Daniel directly listed all of them on the trading market, including Wing of Thunder and Thunderwing Dragon Core!
Most importantly, he listed everything at dirt-cheap prices!
It didn’t take long before someone on the trading market discovered a blackgold-grade material — Thunderwing Dragon Core — priced at only 500 gold coins!
As for the other equipment, Daniel sold them all off at prices far below market value.
And just like that, World Channel No. 616 erupted once more!
"A blackgold-grade Thunderwing Dragon Core for only 500 gold coins? Am I hallucinating from farming too hard?"
"A platinum-grade Wing of Thunder for 100 gold coins? Is this a joke?!"
"Wait, this isn’t a hallucination — look! These low-priced items are all being sold by Faustus!"
"Holy shit! It really is! All items go on sale in 3 hours — all hail Faustus!"
"My god, bronze-grade equipment is only 10 copper coins, and even iron-grade only costs 100 copper coins! Is he giving out福利 to the whole server?"
"Damn... that’s a blackgold-grade material! There’s no way he doesn’t know how valuable it is. Even if he listed it for tens of thousands of gold coins, people would still buy it!"
"No, seriously, he’s dumping all this gear at rock-bottom prices... what’s the point?"
Watching the World Channel instantly fill with 999+ messages, Daniel curled his lips into a faint smile.
Soon, the entire 616th game world would be facing an epic-grade war, and might even have to confront powerful enemies from other worldlines.
He didn’t mind giving the overall player base a moderate boost in strength.
As for selling at a loss?
The buyers might profit, but Daniel, as the seller, would never lose.
The reason he set the sale to begin after 3 hours was also to give more people time to prepare.
After finishing with the equipment, he turned his attention to the deathcurse potions in his bag.
[deathcurse potion (consumable / special item)]

Effect: After use, the next time you kill another player, the target is guaranteed to drop one piece of currently equipped gear, and their level drops by 5. However, if you are killed before that happens, your own level drops by 10.
Description: A curse that wagers everything — either you die, or I do.
Daniel’s mouth twitched.
This thing...
was a little brutal.
Still, it would be perfect for dealing with enemies.
Then he looked at the blackgold-grade treasure chest.
[Ding! Congratulations! You obtained: Hand of Shadow (blackgold-grade)]
[Hand of Shadow (blackgold-grade)]
Type: Gloves (Bound)
Agility: +120
Effect: All elemental damage +25%, ignores 10% of the target’s elemental resistance.
Additional Effect: Attack Speed +15%
Class Restriction: Archer
Level Requirement: 45
Seeing that it was bound, Daniel immediately equipped it.
His current equipment loadout was now: Moon Reaper, Holy Cross, Hand of Shadow, and Merit Medal.
Then his gaze fell upon the final two platinum-grade rewards!
[Blessed Grail (platinum-grade)]
Saint’s Blessing: While in combat, restores 1% MP per second.
Super Growth: Restores 1% MP for every target killed!
Description: A grail blessed by the gods, possessing an extremely rare effect!
[Demon Mask (platinum-grade)]
Poison Fiend: Immune to poison, but carries a random negative status effect.
Undying One: When taking damage, has a chance to randomly negate one instance of damage.
Description: A demon’s mask, with both benefits and drawbacks.
Looking at the two pieces of equipment, Daniel nodded.
Though both items had fairly decent effects, what he truly looked forward to was what they would become after being enhanced a millionfold!
Without the slightest hesitation, he immediately put both pieces of equipment up for auction on the trading market!
Their stats were strong, and they were perfect for draining gold out of those wealthy consortiums through an auction round.
Very soon, another frenzy swept through the World Channel.
"Whoa! Unbelievable — Faustus is actually auctioning off the Blessed Grail? Such a powerful piece of gear!"
"And that Demon Mask is no joke either. Immunity to poison status? Tsk tsk, an item like that would still be god-tier even in the late game!"
"Enough talking. First bid, first benefit. Our Stormbound Guild is taking that Demon Mask. The rest of you should know your place and give up."
(A real-world guild; the game had not yet unlocked guild creation.)
"What a big mouth. If you’ve got the money, buy it. If you don’t, stop barking. Froststar Guild is determined to win it!"
"Hmph! The auction’s started. Let’s see whose wallet talks louder!"
The trading market’s auction only had one requirement:
Cash.
As a result, major real-world financial groups and gaming guilds all started frantically buying up gold coins.
For a time, they forcibly pushed the exchange rate between gold coins and dollars all the way to 1:3!
And even that rate was still climbing.
"50,000 gold coins!"
"Hmph, Stormbound Guild, you really are poor as dirt! Rhine Guild bids 80,000 gold coins!"
"What? This is insane — all that for just one platinum-grade item?"
"You don’t know shit. Setting aside the fact that it’s being auctioned on behalf of Faustus, the item itself is already worth that much..."
As one large guild after another entered the fray, the auction became a spectacle that left countless players utterly dumbfounded!
Those two platinum-grade items were ultimately sold for the astronomical price of 400,000 gold coins!
At the same time, Daniel also received the system notification!
[Ding! Detected that the host sold Blessed Grail and Demon Mask. Triggering Millionfold Boost...]
[Ding! Congratulations! You obtained 400,000,000 gold coins!]
[Congratulations! You obtained Infinite Grail (supreme-grade), Demon’s Whisper (supreme-grade)!]
Daniel’s breathing grew rapid.
Supreme-grade equipment — even he had only ever seen items of that level in the hands of gods!
He hurriedly opened his inventory to inspect them.
[Infinite Grail (supreme-grade / special equipment)]
Effect 1 — Eternal Blessing: While in combat, restores 1% HP and 1% MP per second.
Effect 2 — Slaughter Growth: For every target killed, max HP +1, max MP +1, recovery speed +1%!
Description: A legendary relic of the God of War, one that nourishes itself through slaughter. As long as war endures, it will never cease.
[Demon’s Whisper (supreme-grade / special mask)]
Effect 1 — Demonic Contract: Immune to all negative status effects (poison, curses, stun, fear, etc.), but cannot receive any positive buffs (including buffs from teammates).
Effect 2 — Demonic Protection: When receiving fatal damage, negate that damage and lock HP at 1%. (24-hour cooldown)
Description: A mask traded with demons, exchanging light for absolute freedom.
Infinite Grail... restoring 1% HP and MP every second, even while in combat?
That meant as long as he wasn’t one-shot, he could fight while continuously regenerating both HP and MP.
Combined with Slaughter Growth, the more he killed, the faster he recovered — the longer he fought, the stronger he became!
And Demon’s Whisper granted immunity to all negative status effects!
That meant stuns, freezes, fear, and similar effects would all be useless against him in the future!
Although the price was that he could no longer benefit from buffs, he didn’t rely much on buffs anyway. With a full set of god-tier gear, why would he care about a few extra buffs?
And the once-per-day death immunity essentially meant he had an extra life!
An absolute god-tier ability!
Daniel was overjoyed. Without hesitation, he equipped both items.
The grail turned into a stream of light and merged into his chest, while the mask transformed into a semi-transparent black face covering that settled over his face.
In an instant, he felt two completely different powers surging through his body.
One was an endless flow of vitality.
The other was an icy, absolute form of protection.
Daniel nodded in satisfaction.
Now, all four of his core attributes had reached 755, and with all this equipment on top of that, his combat power had multiplied many times over.
Just as he was thinking that, a sudden commotion broke out around him.
"Faustus is over there!"
"Holy shit, it’s really him!"
"大神! Can I get a photo with you?!"
"Faustus, join my guild! I’ll pay you a million a year!"
"Get lost! Who are you looking down on? Faustus, our Arcane Guild sincerely invites you to join — name your price!"
The crowd surged toward him like a tidal wave, and Daniel frowned.
He had no interest in being treated like some kind of zoo exhibit.
With a single thought, God Speed activated.
His figure vanished from the spot instantly, leaving behind only a mass of fanatical, clueless players still pushing deeper into the crowd...

Daniel was overjoyed.
Without hesitation, he equipped both items.
The grail turned into a stream of light and merged into his chest, while the mask transformed into a semi-transparent black face covering that settled over his face.
In an instant, he felt two completely different powers surging through his body.
One was an endless flow of vitality.
The other was an icy, absolute form of protection.
Daniel nodded in satisfaction.
Now, all four of his core attributes had reached 755, and with all this equipment on top of that, his combat power had multiplied many times over.
Just as he was thinking that, a sudden commotion broke out around him.
"Faustus is over there!"
"Holy shit, it’s really him!"
"大神!
Can I get a photo with you?!"
"Faustus, join my guild!
I’ll pay you a million a year!"
"Get lost!
Who are you looking down on?
Faustus, our Arcane Guild sincerely invites you to join — name your price!"
The crowd surged toward him like a tidal wave, and Daniel frowned.
He had no interest in being treated like some kind of zoo exhibit.
With a single thought, God Speed activated.
His figure vanished from the spot instantly, leaving behind only a mass of fanatical, clueless players still pushing deeper into the crowd...

chapters.title: Chapter 15 -15-A Legendary-Grade Companion — Earthmount Dragon
paragraphs: In the very next second, Daniel was already standing at the entrance to the village chief’s wooden hut in Starter Village.
The old village chief had been sipping tea inside, but the moment he saw someone appear out of thin air, he was so startled that he dropped his teacup.
"Y-you are... Hero, sir?!"
Daniel nodded. "Village Chief, I want to go to the main city."
The old chief focused his gaze and, upon seeing the name Faustus, hurriedly rose to his feet.
After all, Daniel’s Contribution Points were now astonishingly high, and with that Merit Medal on him, he was more than enough of a big shot in the eyes of the NPCs.
"So it is Sir Faustus, the brave warrior! I never expected you to reach Level 50 so quickly. It is indeed time for you to head to the main city."
"I shall prepare a letter of recommendation for you at once!"
With trembling hands, he took a sealed letter out of the cabinet.
[Obtained: Village Chief’s Letter of Recommendation (Required to travel to the main city)]
"Thank you."
Daniel took the letter.
The old chief beamed, then suddenly said, "Allow me to personally activate the teleportation array and send you to the main city..."
Daniel thought for a moment, then nodded. "Then I’ll trouble you."
At this moment, more than a thousand people had already gathered in the village square, most of them players who had just come out of the instance.
They had originally been chatting excitedly and boasting to one another, but the instant they spotted Daniel, the entire place erupted.
"Faustus! Look, that’s Faustus!"
"Holy shit, a Level 50 archer — there’s no way this isn’t hacks, right?!"
"大神, look over here, I’m cute and delicate—"
Under the respectful escort of the village chief, Daniel passed through the crowd expressionlessly and headed toward the teleportation array.
A few people tried to rush forward, only to be stopped by a squad of NPC guards that suddenly appeared.
Leaning on his cane, the old village chief stood before the guard squad and shouted loudly,
"Please make way, everyone! Sir Faustus is the first brave warrior from our Starter Village to head to the main city. Show proper respect!"
With the guard squad forcefully keeping order, the players could only watch helplessly as Daniel walked up to the teleportation array.
Daniel glanced back once. In the eyes of those players were admiration, envy, jealousy... and fanatical fervor.
A faint smile tugged at the corner of his lips.
Then he stepped into the teleportation array.
A flash of white light later, he vanished before everyone’s eyes.
[World Channel]
"He’s gone... He’s seriously so handsome..."
"The village chief and guard squad personally cleared the path for him. I want to act that cool too."
"Yeah, did you notice the village chief’s attitude? WTF, could he be the chief’s illegitimate son or something?"
"Today’s funniest topic: a player is an NPC’s biological son..."
"When will I ever get to the main city..."
"Stop dreaming. He’s Level 50. What level are you?"
"I’m Level 8..."
"Then shut up!"
Before the players could even calm down, another round of system notifications rang out.
[System Announcement!!!]
[Congratulations to player Faustus for becoming the first player to enter the main city — Luminara!]
[Reward: Contribution Points +500, companion egg (blackgold-grade) ×1!]
[As the first player to unlock the main city, your name will be engraved upon Luminara’s gate monument!]
On the streets of Luminara, Daniel had just stepped out of the teleportation array when he heard the system notification.
The surrounding NPC guards all saluted him in unison.
He swept his gaze across the grand yet familiar city before him.
Broad streets, spires soaring into the clouds, merchants and NPCs moving to and fro—
Compared to the desolate Starter Village, this was the true great world!
He first opened his inventory to inspect the companion egg.
Even in his previous lives, no matter how quickly he leveled up, he could never surpass the elite players of the major guilds. As for this companion egg, he had only ever heard rumors of it.
It wasn’t that his foresight had failed him.
It was simply because those major guilds had always trained their people without scruples.
A group of guild members would wear monsters down to low HP, then hand them over to a core member for the finishing blow!
The moment one boss was finished, they would immediately form the next team...
Under those circumstances, even if Daniel had clones of himself, there was no way he could level faster than them!
[Unhatched Companion Egg (blackgold-grade)]
Type: Random-type pet
Description: Must be hatched before its pet type is revealed.
As Daniel was studying it, the World Channel exploded yet again.
[Global Timeline Channel]
"The main city?! Someone entered the main city?!"
"Faustus again?! Does this guy ever stop?!"
"A companion egg? A blackgold-grade one?! I don’t even have a pet yet!"
"大神, are you selling it? I’ll offer 1,000 gold coins!"
"1,000 gold coins and you want a blackgold-grade pet? I’ll offer 5,000!"
"Stop making jokes. I’ll offer 100,000 gold coins!"
Looking at the 99+ private messages flooding in all at once, all of them asking to buy the companion egg, Daniel was about to ignore them all when one message suddenly caught his attention.
[Crimson Soul (Private Message)]: Sir Faustus, hello!
I am the guild leader of Violet Guild. May I ask whether your companion egg is for sale?
I can offer 10,000 gold coins. If that isn’t enough, we can still negotiate.
Daniel raised an eyebrow.
Violet Guild?
Memories from his previous lives surfaced in his mind.
The Violet Consortium Family—one of the top real-world capital powers. Yet in the early stages of this game, they had always kept a low profile.
Their guild leader, Crimson Soul, had likewise seemed ordinary at the start, but later became one of the ten top powerhouses in the game.
And right now, Violet Guild was still just a little-known small guild.
The Violet Consortium was a very traditional industrial financial family. They placed only moderate importance on virtual industries.
So at the moment the servers had just opened, they had not taken this game particularly seriously.
As a result, Violet Guild had remained obscure for quite a while...
Meanwhile, private messages from other guilds were also flooding in like mad.
[Rhine Watcher]: Sir Faustus, we may have neglected you before, but Rhine Guild is willing to pay 1,000,000 gold coins for your companion egg!
[Eternal Hawk]: Eternal Hawk Guild, under the Morgan Consortium, bids 2,000,000 gold coins. We hope you’ll consider it.
[Ragnarok]: 800,000! We can also trade in real life. In reality, we can offer 2 million dollars...
Daniel laughed the moment he saw these messages.
A million gold coins—at the current exchange rate, that was equivalent to two million dollars!
But to a consortium like Morgan, that was little more than pocket change.
Among all those messages, one in particular amused him so much it nearly made him laugh out loud.
[Stormbound Guild]: If you know what’s good for you, you’d better obediently hand over that companion egg. Stormbound Guild may then consider granting you a basic membership slot!
Reading that message, Daniel let out a snort of laughter.
These people’s style of doing things was as absurd as ever.
Ignoring all the chaotic messages, Daniel replied only to Crimson Soul.
"Deal."
Crimson Soul, who was still in Starter Village killing wild boars, froze the moment she saw the notification.
She checked it again and again, just to make sure she hadn’t misread it.
But when she looked at the other party’s basic info and saw that Level 50 displayed there, she was completely stunned. She had never expected him to actually reply to her!
Tentatively, she sent back a message.
"Sir... did you send that to the wrong person?"
"No. I meant you."
After receiving Daniel’s reply, Crimson Soul’s eyes widened instantly.
Still confused, she nonetheless mobilized her resources as quickly as possible and gathered 10,000 gold coins at once.
Then she immediately initiated the trade, afraid Daniel might change his mind!
[Ding! Player Crimson Soul has sent you a trade request!]
Daniel raised an eyebrow, somewhat surprised that she had gathered the money so quickly.
But when he saw Crimson Soul’s level at this point in time, he almost burst out laughing.
One of humanity’s future top ten powerhouses was currently only Level 5!
Crimson Soul sent another message.
"Sir Faustus, thank you for being willing to sell it!"
[Trade Request: Crimson Soul pays 10,000 gold coins in exchange for Unhatched Companion Egg (blackgold-grade)]
Daniel tapped accept.
Trade completed.
[Ding! Detected sold item: Unhatched Companion Egg (blackgold-grade), sold for 10,000 gold coins. Millionfold Boost triggered!]
[Obtained gold coins: 10,000,000,000!]
[Sold item is of the companion egg category. Quality Boost triggered!]
[Congratulations! You obtained: Ancient Dragon Egg (legendary-grade)]
Thump!
Thump, thump!
Daniel’s heart pounded wildly.
A legendary-grade companion egg?!
He opened his inventory. A gigantic egg radiating a dark golden glow lay quietly inside one of the slots, its shell covered in rocky textures, with an unmistakable draconic aura faintly seeping out.
[Ancient Dragon Egg (legendary-grade)]
Species: Earthmount Dragon (Ancient Dragon)
Description: A descendant of the ancient dragon race, possessing the power to control earth and stone. After hatching, it will bind to your soul and never betray you.
Without hesitation, Daniel bit his finger and let a drop of blood fall onto the egg.
The blood was instantly absorbed, and cracks began to spread across the shell.
Crack!
Craack—!
The fissures grew larger and larger.
Then, a stony claw emerged from inside the egg, followed by the entire head.
It was a somewhat majestic dragon’s head, its entire body seemingly formed of rock, with two brilliant yellow crystals for eyes.
[Congratulations! You have hatched a pet: Earthmount Dragon (Ancient Dragon · LV1)]
[Earthmount Dragon (legendary-grade)]
Base Attributes: Strength 500, Constitution 500, Agility 100, Intelligence 100 (increase with level)
Skill 1 — Crystal Cluster Dragon Breath: Attack +10000%; summons a blue crystal forest erupting from the ground, dealing massive piercing damage!
Skill 2 — Body of Stone: Immune to 50% of physical damage; HP recovery speed +200%!
Skill 3 — Power of the Earth: Can manipulate stone for attack or defense; power scales with level!
Skill 4 — Undying and Unextinguished: As long as it remains in contact with the earth, it can consume MP to reconstruct its body and will never truly die!
