chapters.title: Chapter 42 -42-Sanctuary Garden
paragraphs: Daniel watched the World Channel flooding with posts, a faint smile curling at the corners of his lips.
He opened the backend and saw 999+ private messages flooding in—players signing up for the event. Without hesitation, he clicked [Batch Approve].
Now, all players in World #616 were going to be working for him.
All he had to do was sit back and collect three-tenths of the Merit Points while advancing the mission’s progress.
And at the same time, the participating players would grow stronger.
A win-win situation.
He leaned back in his chair and gazed out the window.
Doomgreen Forest... Goblins.
Goblins were one of the lowest-tier intelligent races in the Stellar world. Standing less than 1.2 meters tall, their bodies were covered in dark green skin.
They lived in tribes at the edges of primeval forests, swamps, and other marginal areas, following a strict "survival of the fittest" code.
High Priests and Commanders held the highest authority, while lower-tier Goblins were lowly and expendable at any time.
Overall, the Goblins were weak: normal Goblins ranged from level 10 to 40, relying on numerical advantage.
They excelled in ambushes, traps, and poisoning—despicable tactics—while their raw combat strength lagged far behind other races.
Yet, this race had one defining trait: an extraordinary reproductive rate and astonishing adaptability, able to survive in extreme conditions.
Though often despised by other races, ambitious players frequently used them as cannon fodder.
Speaking of cannon fodder... have you ever witnessed the Fourth Catastrophe?
[Ding! Server-Wide Announcement!!!]
[Ding! With the establishment of 10 guilds, the Guild System is now fully activated!]
[Guild Leaderboard officially online; all guilds will be ranked in real time!]
[Players who strive to build their guilds have a chance to be recorded in Stellar history!]
Golden light flashed as system announcements flooded the World Channel.
[Guild Leaderboard]
1st: Doom (Lv. 3) — Leader: Faustus
2nd: Eternal Eagle Guild (Lv. 2) — Leader: Whitehead Falcon
3rd: Ragnarok (Lv. 2) — Leader: Duskfang
4th: Rhine (Lv. 1) — Leader: Rhine Watcher
5th: Violet (Lv. 1) — Leader: Crimson Soul
[World Channel]
"Holy shit! The guild leaderboard is finally live!"
"Wait, why is Doom Guild in first place again?"
"Faustus is eternal legend!"
"I want to join Doom Guild! Anyone know how?"
"Don’t even think about it; they’re not recruiting right now."
"I can wait! I’ll wait forever—only Doom Guild!"
Daniel smirked at the system notification.
He opened his mail.
[Ding! Congratulations! Your guild "Doom" has ranked 1st on the Guild Leaderboard!]
[Ranking Rewards: Contribution Points +1,000; Gold Coins +10,000; Mysterious Supply Chest ×1]
He casually opened the supply chest.
[Obtained: SS-Rank Construction Blueprint — Aurea Garden]
[Obtained: Rare Materials ×20]
[Obtained: Advanced Reinforcement Stones ×10]
Daniel’s gaze sharpened.
Construction blueprint?
He opened the detailed description.
[Aurea Garden (SS-Rank Guild Building)]
Type: Guild Headquarters Building / Subclass Enhancement
Area: 500 m2
Construction Requirements: Guild Lv. 3+, must own a guild base, consume required resources.
Effects:
Divine Blessing: All subclass players within the garden gain +20% success rate and +50% proficiency gain while crafting or studying.
Inspiration Burst: Chance to trigger "Inspiration Burst" state, producing higher-quality items (5% chance).
Garden Rest: Resting within the garden increases mind power recovery by 200%.
Exclusive Potions: Can cultivate special herbs to craft rare potions.
Description: A magical garden passed down by the Elves, imbued with the blessing of the Nature God. Here, every craftsman can unleash their potential beyond their limits.
Daniel’s eyes shone.
SS-Rank building blueprint!
Subclass enhancement!
He knew better than anyone in the Stellar world how crucial subclasses were.
Alchemists could brew potions, blacksmiths craft equipment, enchanters strengthen attributes, and scribes create scrolls.
A guild’s strength didn’t just depend on combat players, but also on its support players.
And the Aurea Garden could massively improve subclass efficiency.
But...
He placed the blueprint into the guild warehouse.
[Ding! You have sold item: Aurea Garden Construction Blueprint (SS-Rank), sold for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[Item is a special construction blueprint, triggering Quality Boost!]
[Congratulations! You obtained 1 Gold Coin and the Sanctuary Garden Construction Blueprint (Supreme-Grade)]
Golden light flashed, and a blueprint radiating starlight appeared in his inventory.
Daniel inhaled deeply and opened it.
[Sanctuary Garden (Supreme-Grade Guild Building)]
Type: Core Guild Headquarters Building / City-Wide Buff
Area: 2,000 m2
Construction Requirements: Guild Lv. 5+, must own a basic city-level or higher territory, consumes large amounts of rare resources.
Effects:
Base Effects
All subclass players within the sanctuary gain +50% success rate and +200% proficiency when crafting or studying.
Crafting time reduced by 50%.
Divine Blessing (Core Effect)
Subclass players within the sanctuary gain "Divine Blessing" state:
Mind power temporarily increased by 500% (until leaving the sanctuary)
Inspiration Burst chance increased to 25% (higher-quality items)
Rare drop chance +95% (e.g., legendary-grade items)
III. City-Wide Buff
The city containing the sanctuary (including the entire territory) receives:
+50% proficiency gain for all subclass players
+30% commercial prosperity
Greatly increased chance of attracting rare NPCs to settle
Guild Exclusive
Guild members gain +100% guild points when performing subclass activities inside the sanctuary
Can hire sanctuary-exclusive NPC mentors for advanced subclass guidance
Receive "Starlight Blessing" once a week (random attribute boost, lasts 24 hours)
Special Effect: Stellar Resonance
If the guild owns 3 or more Supreme-Grade buildings, all building effects are doubled.

Description: Legend says this was the first temple built by the gods on the mortal plane, teaching humans to master the Strength of Creation. When starlight falls, sparks of wisdom ignite in every craftsman’s heart.
Daniel stared at the description in silence for ten seconds.
Mind power +500% temporarily?
95% success rate?
City-wide subclass buff?
This wasn’t just a guild building—it was a strategic-level nuclear weapon.
If he built this Sanctuary in Polaris City...
Polaris City would quickly become the top subclass hub.
Countless alchemists, blacksmiths, enchanters, and scribes would flock to it.
Commerce, taxes, population, Contribution Points... all would skyrocket.
He took a deep breath to suppress his excitement.
The blueprint was powerful, but required Guild Lv. 5 and a basic city-level territory.
Polaris City was basic city level—just qualified.
He would need to find time to mobilize the top-tier NPC craftsmen of Polaris City.

[Ding!
You have sold item: Aurea Garden Construction Blueprint (SS-Rank), sold for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[Item is a special construction blueprint, triggering Quality Boost!]
[Congratulations!
You obtained 1 Gold Coin and the Sanctuary Garden Construction Blueprint (Supreme-Grade)]
Golden light flashed, and a blueprint radiating starlight appeared in his inventory.
Daniel inhaled deeply and opened it.
[Sanctuary Garden (Supreme-Grade Guild Building)]
Type: Core Guild Headquarters Building / City-Wide Buff
Area: 2,000 m2
Construction Requirements: Guild Lv.
5+, must own a basic city-level or higher territory, consumes large amounts of rare resources.
Effects:
Base Effects
All subclass players within the sanctuary gain +50% success rate and +200% proficiency when crafting or studying.
Crafting time reduced by 50%.
Divine Blessing (Core Effect)
Subclass players within the sanctuary gain "Divine Blessing" state:
Mind power temporarily increased by 500% (until leaving the sanctuary)
Inspiration Burst chance increased to 25% (higher-quality items)
Rare drop chance +95% (e.g., legendary-grade items)
III.
City-Wide Buff
The city containing the sanctuary (including the entire territory) receives:
+50% proficiency gain for all subclass players
+30% commercial prosperity
Greatly increased chance of attracting rare NPCs to settle
Guild Exclusive
Guild members gain +100% guild points when performing subclass activities inside the sanctuary
Can hire sanctuary-exclusive NPC mentors for advanced subclass guidance
Receive "Starlight Blessing" once a week (random attribute boost, lasts 24 hours)
Special Effect: Stellar Resonance
If the guild owns 3 or more Supreme-Grade buildings, all building effects are doubled.
Description: Legend says this was the first temple built by the gods on the mortal plane, teaching humans to master the Strength of Creation.
When starlight falls, sparks of wisdom ignite in every craftsman’s heart.
Daniel stared at the description in silence for ten seconds.
Mind power +500% temporarily?
95% success rate?
City-wide subclass buff?
This wasn’t just a guild building—it was a strategic-level nuclear weapon.
If he built this Sanctuary in Polaris City...
Polaris City would quickly become the top subclass hub.
Countless alchemists, blacksmiths, enchanters, and scribes would flock to it.
Commerce, taxes, population, Contribution Points... all would skyrocket.
He took a deep breath to suppress his excitement.
The blueprint was powerful, but required Guild Lv.
5 and a basic city-level territory.
Polaris City was basic city level—just qualified.
He would need to find time to mobilize the top-tier NPC craftsmen of Polaris City.

chapters.title: Chapter 43 -43-Doom Guild’s Artifact Warehouse
paragraphs: [World Channel]
"Brothers, which guild did you join?"
"I joined Rhine Guild. Their benefits are quite good."
"I joined Ragnarok. The guild master said there will be profit sharing in the future!"
"Hey, do you think Doom Guild accepts new members? I apply every day, but nothing happens..."
"They are number one, of course the threshold is high."
"No matter how high, they should at least give an explanation. Leaving it empty like this?"
"Wait and see, sooner or later they will open. I want to be among the first batch of founding members!"
Daniel watched the discussion in World Channel and smiled.
Indeed, it was the right time.
He opened the guild panel to start operating.
Step One: Selecting the Guild Headquarters
He clicked a location on the map—Polaris City.
[Ping! Are you sure you want to set the guild headquarters in Polaris City?]
[Confirm.]
[Headquarters successfully bound! Doom Guild is officially established in Polaris City!]
Step Two: Filling the Guild Warehouse
He opened his backpack and looked at the mountain of materials, equipment, and skill books.
All of these had been obtained through Millionfold Boost.
They ranged from white-grade, epic-grade, legendary-grade, to supreme-grade.
He stuffed everything into the guild warehouse without hesitation.
[You have stored: 47 pieces of legendary-grade equipment]
[You have stored: 236 pieces of epic-grade equipment]
[You have stored: 1,847 pieces of blackgold-grade equipment]
[You have stored: 12 SSS-grade skill books]
[You have stored: 58 SS-grade skill books]
[You have stored: 327 S-grade skill books]
[You have stored: ...]
System notifications flooded the screen nonstop, lasting for three minutes before stopping.
The warehouse page refreshed.
The top five slots displayed five supreme-grade pieces of equipment, quietly arranged, emitting a
faint golden glow.
Warrior supreme-grade: Titan’s Fury (two-handed greatsword)
Mage supreme-grade: Star Staff
Archer supreme-grade: Sun-Chaser Bow
Priest supreme-grade: Ode to Life (staff)
Summoner supreme-grade: Covenant of All Souls (tome)
Below were the legendary-grade, epic-grade, and blackgold-grade equipment in layers, dazzlingly
arranged.
Each piece indicated its required guild points for exchange.
The amounts ranged from tens of thousands to millions, clearly labeled.
Step Three: Guild Level Upgrade
[Ping! Do you want to spend 10 million gold coins to upgrade the guild to Level 4?]Confirm.
[Ping! Do you want to spend 50 million gold coins to upgrade the guild to Level 5?]
Confirm.
[Ping! Do you want to spend 200 million gold coins to upgrade the guild to Level 9?]
Confirm.
Golden light flashed continuously as the guild level surged.
[Doom Guild current level: Lv.9]
[Maximum members: 100,000,000]
[Guild skill slots: 5,000]
[Guild warehouse capacity: 1,000,000 slots]
Step Four: Member Rank System
Daniel opened the settings panel and began setting ranks.
Member levels:
F-Rank (Apprentice Member) — initial level
E-Rank (Official Member) — 1,000 guild points
D-Rank (Elite-grade Member) — 5,000 guild points
C-Rank (Core Member) — 20,000 guild points
B-Rank (Steward) — 100,000 guild points
A-Rank (Founder) — 1,000,000 guild points
S-Rank (Councilor) — requires guild master approval
SS-Rank (Vice Guild Master Nominee) — special contributions
SSS-Rank (Honorary Vice Guild Master) — special contributions
Guild point acquisition methods:
Completing guild missions
Donating materials
Participating in guild activities
Special: can be purchased with gold coins (10 gold coins = 1 guild point)
Step Five: Setting the Joining Threshold
Daniel thought for a moment and entered a number.
[Joining the guild requires: 100 copper coins]
It was called a threshold but actually was just a procedural fee to interact with the system.
100 copper coins was affordable to anyone.
Moreover, joining didn’t guarantee retention; the real selection would come later.
Everything was ready.
Daniel posted a recruitment message in World Channel.
[Doom Guild is now officially recruiting!]
[Guild Level: Lv.9]
[Guild Headquarters: Polaris City]
[Guild Benefits:]
Warehouse open: equipment, skill books, and materials below epic-grade, redeemable with guild points
Display of high-level equipment: supreme-grade items waiting for you
Daily guild missions, easily earn guild points
Regularly organized instances and boss events
[Joining Conditions:]
Only for players from Universe 616
Pay 100 copper coins as a joining fee
Click to apply, instant approval!
[Limited slots, first come first served!]
World Channel paused for a second, then completely erupted.
"What the heck?! Level 9???"
"Did I see that right? I just saw Doom Guild at Level 3. How did it jump to 100?!"
"What? Supreme-grade equipment, what is that? Is this a guild warehouse or an artifact museum?!"
"Only for Universe 616! I’m 616! Hahaha, I want to join!"
"100 copper coins to enter? That’s basically free!"
"Charge!!!!"
Daniel’s system panel began flashing wildly.
[Player "Celestial Singer" applied to join the guild]
[Player "Black Falcon" applied to join the guild]
[Player "T-Rex Warrior" applied to join the guild]
[Player "..."]
Applications came like snowflakes, thousands per second, the alert sounds blending together, impossible to count individually.
Daniel opened the batch operation and selected [Approve All].
[Ping! New members joined: 327]
[Ping! New members joined: 1,847]
[Ping! New members joined: 5,236]
The guild channel was instantly flooded with newcomers.
"Holy shit! I’m in!!!"
"Brothers, I’m new here, please take care of me. Can each give me a copper coin?"
"Where’s the warehouse? I want to see!"
"Holy shit! Holy shit!!!"
"This warehouse... I’m blinded!"
"Supreme-grade equipment?! Is this real?!"
"47 legendary-grade pieces! I counted! 47 in total!"
"12 SSS-grade skill books! I see them!"
"This... this... is this even possible? The server is only three days old!"
"How rich is this Faustus?!?"
"I’m not leaving! No way, I’m staying!"
"No, I’ll report Faustus. This is blatant cheating. GM, ban him now!"
"Why only Universe 616? Universe 666 players are rejected? Doom Guild is doomed!"
"That’s right, from now on, anyone from Doom Guild must be killed until no one dares to join. Faustus, you’d better give us a chance..."
The flood of chat continued endlessly, thousands of messages per second, with players shouting and reacting in chaos.
At the same time, players who had already joined guilds immediately opened their warehouses.
And they went insane!
A level-35 warrior stared at the Supreme-Grade "Titan’s Wrath" with shaking hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 44 -44-Other Guild Members Quit in Droves, Rhine’s Chairman Tempted
paragraphs: At the same time, the players who had already joined the guild immediately opened the warehouse.
Then, they went insane!
A level 35 warrior stared at the supreme-grade Titan’s Fury, trembling so much his hands shook.
"Two million guild points... can I save that in a year?"
A level 42 mage stared fixedly at the Star Staff, eyes wide and unblinking.
"Two and a half million guild points... can I trade a kidney for it?"
A level 28 priest knelt down in front of the Ode to Life.
"Mom, I’ve made it. I’m in the same guild as a supreme-grade piece of equipment!"
Meanwhile, the far-sighted players had already begun studying how to earn guild points.
"Ten gold coins equal one guild point... two million guild points would be twenty million gold coins..."
"Twenty million gold coins... at the current soaring exchange rate, that’s roughly one hundred million dollars..."
"One hundred million dollars for a supreme-grade item... worth it! Absolutely worth it!"
"The problem is, we don’t have a hundred million!"
"Then we’ll just do tasks honestly and save slowly."
"That’s true, at least there’s hope! Not to mention supreme-grade, other guilds don’t even have blackgold-grade equipment!"
[World Channel]
"Brothers, have you joined Doom Guild?"
"Already joined! It’s amazing!"
"The warehouse has everything! I exchanged for a gold-grade staff, and my damage output doubled immediately!"
"I exchanged for an S-grade skill book. It cost me thirty thousand guild points, but it’s worth it!"
"How did you exchange it? I haven’t saved enough yet."
"Buy it with money! As long as you have the cash, guild points rise fast!"
"I want a divine artifact too! Please send me one!"
[Rhine Guild]
At this moment, the atmosphere here was so tense it seemed ready to drip water.
Chairman Rhine Watcher stared at the screen, his face dark as iron.
Vice Chairman North Wind spoke cautiously, "Chairman, our guild... three hundred members have quit."
"They all went to Doom Guild."
"I know."
"And several core members also resigned..."
"What?!"
Rhine Watcher stood up abruptly. "Who?"
"...Dragon Slayer. He quit too."
The channel fell into dead silence.
After a long pause, Prospector spoke from the corner.
"Sigh, forget him. I... also want to quit."
"You?!"
Rhine Watcher widened his eyes. "You’re one of the founders of Rhine!"
Prospector smiled bitterly. "You don’t understand."
"My people just went to see Doom Guild’s warehouse."
"Five supreme-grade items, forty-seven legendary-grade, two hundred thirty-six epic-grade, one thousand eight hundred forty-seven blackgold-grade..."
"Twelve SSS-grade skill books, fifty-eight SS-grade, three hundred twenty-seven S-grade..."
He paused, his voice hoarse.
"With a guild like that, I’m tempted myself!"
Rhine Watcher and the rest of the leadership were left in complex emotions, silently speechless for a long time.
[Ragnarok]
"Hahaha, I’m dying laughing. Dragon Slayer from Rhine Guild quit!"
"Their chairman’s face must be green right now!"
"Don’t laugh. Over four hundred members from our guild quit as well."
"Um... Chairman, I also have something to tell you..."
Duskfang took a deep breath. "You also want to quit?"
"No, no. I just want to ask... can I join two guilds at the same time?"
"Get out!"
[Eternal Eagle Guild]
"Mr. Moore, over one thousand members quit from our guild."
"I know."
"Should we also..."
"Also what? Go to Doom Guild?"
The representative from Morgan Consortium fell silent for a few seconds, then slowly spoke.
"Send someone to contact Faustus. See if he’s willing to cooperate."
"If he agrees, we can invest, provide resources, give him everything he wants."
"And if he refuses..."
"And if he refuses?"
"Then... forget it."
"Forget it?"
"What else? Do you want to block him at the respawn point and threaten him to transfer all artifacts to us?"
[Stormbound Guild]
Vantheon’s face was dark as iron. The cup in his hand creaked under his grip.
"Chairman, over three thousand members quit from our guild..."
"Shut up!"
"I said shut up!"
Vantheon threw the cup to the ground. It shattered into pieces.
"Faustus... Faustus!!!"
He ground his teeth, filled with impotent rage.
Meanwhile, the World Channel for Universe 616 had already turned into a sea of joy.
"Long live Faustus!"
"Friends from other worlds, are you jealous? Envious? Hahaha!"
"Come, come, here’s a screenshot of our guild’s warehouse!"
[Image——]
"Holy shit! Supreme-grade!"
"Is this real? This isn’t Photoshop, right?"
"Photoshop my foot! This is an actual screenshot!"
"I don’t believe it! I can’t believe Universe 616 has a guild this insane!"
"Don’t believe it, doesn’t matter. We’re enjoying it anyway."
"Wuwuwu, I also want to join Doom Guild... but I’m not 616."
"Don’t cry. Come to our world, we’ll try together!"
"Cross-world migration? Is that even possible?"
"Don’t know, just saying, it shouldn’t be a big problem!"
"F*** squid..."
Daniel watched the celebration on World Channel, his lips curling into a slight smile.
He opened the guild panel.
Just over a million more to reach full capacity.
He thought for a moment, then sent another message.
[Doom Guild Recruitment Countdown]
[Only 1 million slots remaining, first come first served!]
[Miss today, wait another year!]
As soon as the message was sent, applications surged again.
Ten minutes later.
[Ping! Guild has reached maximum members! Recruitment stopped!]
World Channel immediately filled with wails.
"What??? Full already???"
"I just got off work! Haven’t applied yet!"
"Please, God, open more slots! I beg you!"
"One hundred million members still not enough?"
"Of course not, nearly one billion players on Earth. One hundred million is too few!"
"God, when will you expand recruitment?"
"Same question, same question!"
Daniel thought for a moment and replied.
"No expansion for now. The guild needs time to integrate. There will be opportunities in the future!"
World Channel fell into wailing again.
But the players who had already joined were showing off wildly.
"Hahaha, I’m in!"
"You guys wait outside slowly. I’m going to exchange gear first!"
"Such generosity! Long live the God!"
At the same time, a blood-red system announcement rang out across the entire Stellar World.
[Global Announcement!!!]
[Ping! Current online player count has reached 10 billion!]
[World-class event "Beast Maze" officially starts!]

At the same time, a blood-red system announcement rang out across the entire Stellar World.
[Global Announcement!!!]
[Ping!
Current online player count has reached 10 billion!]
[World-class event "Beast Maze" officially starts!]

chapters.title: Chapter 45 -45-World-Class Event: Beast Maze
paragraphs: [Ding! Server-Wide Announcement!!!]
[World-Class Event "Beast Maze" officially begins!]

[Event Description: In ancient times, Humans and the Magical Beast race waged a cataclysmic war, both sides losing their elites. Now, the Beast Maze has reappeared in the world. All adventurers may enter the maze, explore the unknown, and acquire treasures!]
[Participation: Click the event icon to register; maps are assigned randomly.]
[Event Rules:]
No level restrictions; all players may register.
Upon entry, all players are randomly assigned to maps of varying difficulty (1–10 stars).
All items obtained during the event may be taken back into the main game world.
Upon death, players may enter spectator mode to watch others, tip, or leave comments.
At the event’s conclusion, ranking rewards are distributed according to performance.
[Special Note: High-difficulty maps are extremely dangerous; proceed with caution!]
"Holy shit! What’s going on? 10 billion players online simultaneously? World-class event!"
"This event is for 10 billion players! How massive must it be?"
"Good grief, this recruitment by World #616 probably triggered the entire Stellar world’s online population!"
"No, it’s Faustus’s power! One person alone drove the whole game’s population online!"
"666, no need for theatrics, this Faustus isn’t even a GM!"
"Beast Maze? Sounds exciting!"
"No level restrictions! I’m only level 20, can I participate?!"
"Brothers, charge!"
"Sign me up!"
Daniel frowned slightly at the announcement.
A world-class event for 10 billion simultaneous players—he was aware of this, but hadn’t expected the number to hit so fast.
In his memory, there were still a few days before such an event. Could it really be, as the World Channel suggested, that his guild recruitment had detonated the entire Stellar world’s player count?
The truth was unknown, but Daniel didn’t panic.
He had long been mentally prepared for butterfly-effect consequences.
As for this Beast Maze...
In his previous four lives, he had experienced numerous world-class events.
But he had never seen one called "Beast Maze."
What was this about?
Could it be that his current reincarnation had altered something?
He shook his head and stopped thinking.
Regardless, the rewards for a world-class event were substantial—real and tangible.
Just like the event he previously activated with the Dark God Anti-Holy Grail, he simply had to participate.
He clicked the event icon to register.
[Ding! Registration successful!]
[Assigning map...]
[Assignment complete!]
[You have been assigned to: 9-Star Difficulty Map — Beast God Phantom]
[Good luck!]
In the next instant, white light flashed.
Daniel opened his eyes to find himself standing inside a massive iron cage.
Around him were nine other players, all wearing the same drab yellow prison uniform with a number printed on the chest.
Daniel glanced at his status.
His equipment was gone, inventory locked, and skill bar grayed out.
A system notification soon appeared.
[Ding! You have entered the event map: Beast God Phantom (9-Star Difficulty)]
[Current Status: Imprisoned]
[Mission Hint: Your equipment has been confiscated. Proceed with caution!]
[Special Note: This map has a very high death rate. Exercise extreme caution!]
Daniel’s eyes narrowed.
The warning emphasized caution twice, and with his equipment temporarily unavailable, it was clear that this event would not be simple.
In the cage, the other nine players were slowly coming to their senses.
"Holy shit! Where’s my gear?!"
"Is this a system bug? My skills don’t work! How can I play without summoning my puppets?!"
"Where is this? Why is it so dark?"
"Listen, I hear beasts! I hear beasts howling!"
Outside, low guttural roars vibrated the iron cage.
One player lunged toward the bars, shaking them furiously.
"Let me out! Let me out!"
"Stop screaming! It’s useless!"
"Then what? Just wait to die?"
"The system says there’s a mission, there must be a chance."
"I don’t care! You idiots, silently waiting to die—anyone, open this cage!"
As his voice faded, a huge figure appeared outside the cage.
A magical beast over three meters tall, its body covered in black scales, holding a massive wolf-tooth club in its mouth.
[Magical Beast Guard · LV25 (Iron-Grade)]
It rapped the club against the cage, producing a harsh metallic clang.
"Making noise! Keep it up and I’ll crush you all!"
The player shaking the cage froze in terror but still shouted:
"Why am I locked up? Let me out!"
The Magical Beast Guard grinned, baring sharp teeth.
"Why? Because I said so!"
It opened the cage, grabbed the player by the neck, and lifted him out.
Snap!
The player’s neck was crushed, and the body was tossed aside.
[System Notification: Player "Raging Warrior" has been eliminated, entering spectator mode]
The remaining nine players in the cage went completely silent.
Meanwhile, in Spectator Mode,
Eliminated players appeared one after another, quickly gathering into hundreds of thousands.
"Holy shit, this event is way too hard! I died three minutes after entering!"
"You died in three minutes? I got squashed by a magical beast in one minute!"
"What star map are you on?"
"Three-star."
"Five-star."
"I... nine-star."
All eyes turned toward them.
Raging Warrior grimaced. "My luck... randomly assigned to the nine-star map."
"Nine-star?! What the hell?"
"I don’t know. I spawned in a cage, no gear, and got crushed by the magical beast."
"Did you see the other players?"
"Yes, nine others were locked in with me."
"They’re still inside?"
"Yes, when I died, the Magical Beast Guard locked the cage again."
Speculation and chatter rose, when suddenly someone shouted:
"Wait! That person... is that Faustus?!"
Raging Warrior froze and quickly looked at the spectator display.
The nine-star map’s live feed showed a player in a yellow prison uniform standing in the corner of the cage.
Calm, composed, eyes cold and steady.
It was Daniel.
"Holy shit! He’s from World #616, it really is him!"
"Faustus in a nine-star map?! His luck is a little rough!"
"Master, go! Take down those magical beasts!"
"With Master in the nine-star map, victory is guaranteed!"
"Don’t celebrate too soon—he has no gear and skills are disabled. How can he fight?"
"Uh... true."
"Let’s see. Maybe a miracle will happen."
At that moment, another group of Magical Beast Guards approached.
Leading them was an even larger Magical Beast, wearing intricate leather armor and wielding a whip.
[Magical Beast Squad Leader · LV35 (Silver-Grade)]
It arrived at the cage containing Daniel, rapping the bars with its whip.
"These few, take them out."
The guards opened the cage and forced Daniel and the other nine players out.
"Move! Hurry!"
The ten players were herded down a long corridor and into a massive circular arena.
Around them, tiered stands were packed with Magical Beasts, roaring excitedly.
At the center of the arena stood an enormous figure.
[Magical Beast Commander · LV50 (Platinum-Grade BOSS)]

chapters.title: Chapter 46 -46-Welcome to the Arena?
paragraphs: [Magical Beast Commander · Kales, LV50 (Platinum-Grade BOSS)]
The commander was clad in ornate armor, holding a flaming longsword, towering over them.
"Welcome to the Arena, pitiful humans," it thundered.
"Today, you have one chance to survive."
"Ten of you will fight each other. The last one standing may go attend to your Human prince."
"How merciful, isn’t it?"
The stands erupted with deafening cheers from the magical beasts.
"Kill! Kill! Kill!"
Meanwhile, in Daniel’s view, every player in spectator mode exploded in shock.
"Holy shit! Free-for-all?!?"
"What kind of twisted rule is this?!"
"What about Faustus?"
"He’s strong, but he has no equipment!"
"It’s over, nine-star maps aren’t for humans..."
Just then, another group of Magical Beast Guards pushed a small cart into the arena.
The cart was stacked with equipment, neatly arranged for all ten players.
Commander Kales waved its hand.
"Return their gear. Make it a fair fight."
"Now it’s fun!"
The guards opened the cart, motioning for each player to take their own equipment.
Daniel stepped forward, and a flash of white light appeared. The system automatically equipped him with Moon Reaper and the Windstrider Set.
The moment the gear settled on his body, familiar Strength coursed through him.
A small smirk appeared on Daniel’s lips.
Fairness!
Hm? Fairness? Even without gear, he could probably have killed this Magical Beast Commander.
Now with equipment... it was time to think about how to have fun.
The other nine players quickly donned their gear, glancing at each other nervously.
The arena’s atmosphere grew tense.
[Ding! Temporary Quest Triggered: Arena Decision]
[Objective: Be the last survivor]
[Rewards: Event Points +1,000, Gold-Grade Treasure Chest ×1]
[Note: Killing other players grants additional points]
A warrior-type player’s eyes flickered. Suddenly, he lunged.
"Sorry, brother!"
He raised his greatsword and swung at a nearby mage.
Before the blade could land, an arrow pierced his head.
Pfft!
Instant kill.
His body collapsed with a thud.
Everyone froze, staring toward the direction the arrow came from.
Daniel stood there, bow in hand, expressionless.
"Want to survive? Don’t move."
[Spectator Mode]
"Holy shit! Master Faustus just acted!"
"One arrow, instant kill! So cool!"
"That warrior really deserved that—attacking in front of Faustus? Suicide!"
"Master is invincible!"
"Invincible my ass, next he’s probably going to hunt the rest of them!"
Daniel glanced at the message prompts but ignored them.
Commander Kales watched the scene, excitement flashing in its eyes.
"Good! Excellent! Wonderful!"
It pointed at Daniel.
"You! Kill the remaining ones!"
"Then you’ll be the victor!"
The remaining eight players paled and instinctively stepped back, wary of Daniel.
But Daniel didn’t move.
He slowly turned toward the Magical Beast Commander and smiled.
"You want me to kill them? Just like that?"
"Who do you think you are?"
As he spoke, he drew his bow.
Aetherlance!
The golden spear tore through the air, instantly piercing the commander’s chest.
Boom—!
The commander’s HP emptied instantly.
It stared at the massive hole in its chest, disbelief in its eyes.
Before it could finish, its massive body collapsed.
[Ding! You have killed Magical Beast Commander (Gold-Grade BOSS)]
[Event Points +5,000]
[Gold Coins +100]
[Obtained Equipment: Flame Sword (Gold-Grade) ×1]
The arena went silent.
The magical beasts in the stands froze.
The eight remaining players on the field froze.
Hundreds of thousands in spectator mode froze.
Then, the next second, the spectators erupted.
"Holy shit!!!"
"He killed the event BOSS?!"
"Is Master Faustus insane?!"
"No way, how dare he?!"
"So cool! So freaking cool!"
"This is the real Master! The true god!"
"Tip! Everyone tip him!"
[Player "T-Rex Mage" tipped 1 gold coin]
[Player "Nightingale" tipped 5 gold coins]
[Player "...."]
The tip notifications spamed uncontrollably, impossible to track who gave what.
On the arena field, the magical beasts reacted, roaring in fury.
"Kill him!!!"
"Kill that human!!!"
Hundreds of magical beasts leapt from the stands, charging Daniel.
The eight players turned pale, immediately spinning around and running.
"Run!"
"This guy’s crazy! Forget him!"
"Make sure he doesn’t follow us! Escape while you can!"
They fled toward the arena’s edges, disappearing into the corridors.
Of course, these magical beasts were at worst LV30 Iron-Grade mobs, comparable to the fleeing players—this wasn’t difficult for Daniel.
The real limit was the event’s one-life rule. Otherwise, even if the opponents were gods, they would have fought.
Daniel didn’t even glance at the fleeing teammates.
He raised his bow.
Arrowstorm!
A hail of arrows poured down, blanketing the entire arena.
Boom boom boom boom boom—!
Explosions and fire roared as the smoke cleared.
The arena was littered with corpses.
[Ding! You have killed Magical Beast Guards ×327]
[Event Points +9,810]
[Gold Coins +3,700]
[Obtained Equipment: Bronze-Grade ×47, Iron-Grade ×23, Silver-Grade ×5]
The ground was strewn with dropped equipment and silver coins, glittering in the light.
[Spectator Mode]
"...I’m blind."
"One move, hundreds of magical beasts killed?"
"Is this even human?"
"I suddenly feel... nine-star maps aren’t that hard?"
"Not hard? You try it!"
"I’m not going. I’m afraid of dying."
"Hahahahaha..."
At that moment, the eight fleeing players suddenly returned.
They charged from the corridors, eyes fixed on the scattered equipment and silver coins.
"Holy shit! So much loot!"
"Grab it!"
They rushed, stuffing the loot into their backpacks, cursing as they went.
"That idiot killed the BOSS but didn’t pick up the loot! Lucky for us!"
"Yeah, must be crazy!"
"Hahaha, whoever grabs it keeps it! Thanks, big brother, for the loot!"
Suddenly, someone stopped and frowned at Daniel.
"Hey! You killed the Magical Beast Commander! Who’s going to lead us for the next task?"
The others realized and turned to him.
"Yeah! You killed the BOSS, what do we do?"
"This event is about rescuing the prince. Without the commander leading, how can we find him?"
"Are you stupid?"
"Compensate us for the mission!"
The eight crowded around, aggressively questioning Daniel.
They didn’t know that the person before them was the legendary Faustus.
Because in the event, before dying, all players were anonymous.
[Spectator Mode]
"??? What are these idiots doing?"
"They actually dared to yell at Master Faustus?!"
"Are they looking for death?"
"Hahahahaha, this is going to be interesting!"
"Does Master Faustus really tolerate talking back?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 47 -47-Slaying the Beast God
paragraphs: Daniel looked at the eight reckless fools in front of him, a faint smile tugging at his lips.
"What did you just say? Say it again?"
A warrior straightened his neck and shouted, "I said you’re an idiot!"
"Killing the BOSS and not picking up loot! And now we have no missions!"
"Exactly! Compensate us for the missions!"
"Do you even know how long we’ve been waiting to enter this map?"
"What now? You take responsibility?"
Daniel nodded.
"Fine. I’ll take responsibility."
He drew his bow and unleashed Shattering Comet!
Whoosh whoosh whoosh whoosh—!
Eight arrows split almost simultaneously.
Pfft pfft pfft pfft—!
Eight heads exploded at once.
[Ding! You have killed Players ×8]
[Event Points +480]
Eight bodies collapsed to the ground with a thunderous crash.
[Spectator Mode]
"Hahahahaha...!"
"Where did this godly player come from? I’m dying laughing! How dare they insult him!"
"Master Faustus: ’I take responsibility’? No problem, I’ll send you all on your way!"
"Those idiots should now know who they were insulting."
"Look—they’ve entered spectator mode!"
The eight players had just respawned in spectator mode, still confused.
"Holy shit! How dare he kill us?!"
"He killed all eight of us alone?!"
"Report him! I’m reporting him for malicious PK!"
Messages flooded in instantly—tens of thousands appearing on the bulletin board.
"You shameless beasts! He solved the crisis, and you dare insult him?!"
"Insult all you want, so what?"
One player sneered.
"Look carefully—do you even know who that person is?"
The eight players looked up at the screen.
Daniel was bending down, picking up a piece of loot. His face was clear, visible for all to see.
His ID floated above his head.
[Faustus.Lv100]
The eight players’ faces drained of color instantly.
"Fa... Faustus?!"
"That guy is Faustus?!"
"I... I just insulted Faustus?!"
"It’s over..."
Laughter erupted all around.
"Hahaha, how does it feel to insult a god?"
"Apologize to the Master—maybe he’ll forgive you."
"Apologize? Such ingratitude deserves to be tossed out!"
"Exactly! If I met these ingrates in the real world, I’d feed them to sharks!"
The eight could only whimper, wishing they could sink into the floor, and shamefully exited the spectator mode.
On the field, Daniel finished picking up all the loot.
He opened the map and checked the mission objective:
[Rescue the Captured Human Prince!]
The target was deep within the maze, marked by a golden light.
By normal logic, he should stealthily sneak in, avoid the magical beasts, locate the prince, and rescue him.
But Daniel had other plans.
The mission only said to rescue the prince—it didn’t specify how.
As long as the prince lived, the process clearly didn’t matter.
As for the magical beasts...
He looked at the dense red dots on the map—their likely gathering points.
All points were rewards!
Daniel grinned.
He closed the map and strode toward the direction with the highest concentration of magical beasts.
For the next two hours, the entire Beast Maze descended into chaos.
A lone human moved east to west, south to north, leaving nothing alive in his path.
[Ding! You have killed Magical Beast Guard ×1, Event Points +30]
[Ding! You have killed Magical Beast Warrior ×1, Event Points +50]
[Ding! You have killed Magical Beast Captain ×1, Event Points +200]
[Ding! You have killed...]
System notifications flashed endlessly.
Daniel was like a one-man reaping machine—anywhere he went, death followed.
Lone enemies? One arrow.
Small squads? One arrow.
Hundreds of beasts? Still one arrow.
Arrowstorm covered the entire field; Aetherlance singled out BOSSes.
Almost no magical beast could withstand him.
[Spectator Mode]
The audience had gone numb.
From initial astonishment to now dazed "oh-oh" sounds.
"How many has he killed?"
"Don’t know, but the points must be in the hundreds of thousands."
"I counted—he killed 327 in the last wave. Points... too lazy to calculate."
"This is the world of a god?"
"So effortless, barely needed a second move..."
Then, the entire maze suddenly trembled violently.
A massive pressure descended from above, shrouding the ninth level.
Spectators’ faces went pale instantly.
"What’s happening?!"
"Such overwhelming presence!"
"I feel like I can’t even breathe through the screen!"
"Look at the sky!"
On the main screen, a massive shadow slowly formed.
A gigantic magical beast, tens of meters tall, covered in golden scales, with three pairs of wings on its back and a spiraling horn crackling with lightning.
[Beast God Phantom · LV50 (Legendary-Grade BOSS)]
[Skills: Beast Might as Prison, Thunderous Wrath, Beast God’s Fury...]
[Description: A projection of the Beast God’s will. Though only one ten-thousandth of the original’s power, it remains invincible to mortals.]
[Spectator Mode]
"Holy shit! Legendary-Grade BOSS!"
"LV50 Legendary? Way stronger than normal BOSS!"
"450,000 HP and insane skills—how do we fight this?!"
"It’s over, Master Faustus is going to fail!"
"Run, Master! Don’t face it head-on!"
"Run? Can anyone escape?"
"Master Faustus, listen to me—retreat first, plan strategically!"
"Yes, yes, retreat first, then figure it out!"
Spectators frantically sent messages.
But Daniel didn’t even glance at them.
He simply looked up at the massive shadow, a faint smile on his lips.
"Beast God Phantom?"
"I expected something formidable... but this?"
Of course, he knew the BOSS’s true nature.
If the real Beast God appeared here, he would be instantly killed.
But a projection?
Piece of cake.
Moreover, this was a world-class event.
The system would never design a BOSS unbeatable by all players.
High-difficulty map monsters were generally not high-level—that was the reason.
Daniel lifted his bow.
The Beast God Phantom seemed to sense danger and let out a deafening roar.
"Insignificant human! How dare you defy the majesty of the gods!"
"Die!"
It opened its massive maw, sending a thick bolt of lightning toward Daniel.
Daniel God Speed flashed, easily dodging.
He drew his bow.
Aetherlance!
The golden spear tore through the sky, piercing the Beast God Phantom’s chest.
Boom—!
Another shot:
Two arrows later, the Beast God Phantom’s HP emptied instantly.
Its eyes widened in disbelief.
"This... how is this possible..."
Before it could finish, the colossal projection shattered, dispersing into countless glowing fragments.

chapters.title: Chapter 48 -48-Threaten Me?
paragraphs: [Spectator Mode]
The once-bustling message board had gone utterly silent.
Hundreds of thousands of spectators were frozen.
Eyes wide, mouths agape, like statues.
One second.
Two seconds.
Three seconds.
"Holy shit?!"
"Two arrows... and it’s dead?!"
"A 450,000 HP Legendary-Grade BOSS... just like that?!"
"Am I seeing things?!"
"Is this even humanly possible?!"
"Master Faustus... are you a god?!"
"No way! I refuse to believe it! This must be an illusion!"
"Screenshot! Record it! Quick! This is historic!"
"Tip him! Everyone tip! Go all out!"
[Player tipped you 10 gold coins]
[Player tipped you 15 gold coins]
[Player tipped you 20 gold coins]
[Player "...."]
Tip notifications spamed uncontrollably, impossible to track who was tipping.
The numbers skyrocketed, quickly surpassing one million gold coins.
Meanwhile, Daniel was checking his BOSS kill rewards.
[Ding! You have killed Beast God Phantom (Legendary-Grade BOSS)]
[Event Points +90,000,000]
[Obtained Special Item: Beast God’s Fang (One-Time Use)]
Beast God’s Fang (Special)
Effect: When used, it replaces the Beast God to enter the 10-Star Difficulty Map — Snowland Sacred Spring.
Description: A fang imbued with the aura of the Beast God, capable of occupying the Beast God’s position in specific scenarios.
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
10-Star Map? Snowland Sacred Spring?
The event introduction had explained maps from 1–10 stars. Unsurprisingly, the 10-star map should be the hidden ultimate area.
He hadn’t expected that entering it required a specific token.
He carefully stowed the fang and continued toward his mission objective.
After the Beast God Phantom dissipated, the entire magical beast settlement fell into temporary silence.
Those hiding in the shadows, trembling, had witnessed the god they revered get obliterated by a single arrow—their minds went blank.
Daniel lowered his bow and scanned the surroundings.
In a corner, a trembling Magical Beast Commander tried to sneak away.
[Magical Beast Commander · Grom (LV55, Gold-Grade BOSS)]
Daniel God Speed flashed, appearing instantly before it.
"Where do you think you’re going?"
Grom’s legs buckled, and it fell to its knees.
"M-Master, spare me! I was blind! I deserve death!"
Daniel looked down at it calmly.
"Take me to the Human prince."
Grom’s eyes shifted, calculating quickly.
This human was absurdly strong—even the Beast God had been killed...
But the magical beast race still had tens of thousands of troops in the maze. If it could hold the prince, it had bargaining power.
It raised its head, a glint of cunning in its eyes.
"I’ll guide you... but you must agree to a condition."
"Speak."
"Spare the lives of all magical beasts! Otherwise... I’ll have the Human prince killed!"
It straightened its back, trying to show confidence.
"I know you’re strong, but no one outruns my communication token. With a single thought, the prince’s head will fall!"
"How about it? Fair trade, right?"
It looked at Daniel proudly, expecting him to compromise.
Daniel paused for a second. Then he smiled.
"Fair?"
He nodded.
"Fine, I’ll give you the fairness you want."
He drew his bow.
Arrowstorm! Shattering Comet!
Two skills activated simultaneously.
Golden arrows swirled with splitting meteors, raining down in an unstoppable torrent over the entire magical beast settlement.
Boom boom boom boom boom—!
Explosions rocked the sky, fire erupted everywhere.
Grom’s eyes widened; before it could react, it was engulfed in the inferno.
Ten seconds later, the smoke cleared.
The magical beast settlement was a grim ruin.
Tens of thousands of magical beasts had perished, blood staining the battlefield.
[Ding! You have killed Magical Beast Warrior ×12,847]
[Ding! You have killed Magical Beast Guard ×8,236]
[Ding! You have killed Magical Beast Captain ×537]
[Ding! You have killed Magical Beast Commander ×23]
[Event Points +100,847,200]
[Gold Coins +68,000]
[Obtained Equipment: Gold-Grade ×12, Blackgold-Grade ×3, Epic-Grade ×1]
Daniel lowered his bow and looked at Grom’s corpse.
"Negotiate with me?"
"You think you’re worthy?"
[Spectator Mode]
"Holy shit!!!"
"What a joke! One move and tens of thousands of magical beasts?!"
"Is that an archer or a human nuclear bomb?!"
"Points increased by over a hundred million! Am I seeing correctly?!"
"That commander’s brain must be fried—he dared to threaten Master Faustus?!"
"Exactly! He should have obediently led him. Instead, he tried to die!"
"Laughing... he thought he had Master Faustus under control, but Master just flipped the table."
[Player tipped 50 gold coins]
[Player tipped 30 gold coins]
[Player tipped 10 gold coins]
[Player "...."]
After annihilating the magical beast settlement, Daniel calmly activated Divine Perception.
Within a one-kilometer radius, all living beings’ positions instantly appeared in his mind.
Southeast, deep underground—a human life signal.
No doubt, it must be the dungeon holding the prince.
He vanished in an instant.
Deep in the dungeon.
A young man in tattered noble clothes was curled in a corner.
His face pale, lips cracked.
[Human Prince · Alfred (LV30, Special NPC)]
Hearing footsteps, he raised his head, eyes flashing with fear.
"Y-you... are you here to kill me?"
Daniel shot the chains with an arrow and pushed the cell door open.
"You’re safe, Your Highness. I’m here to rescue you."
The prince froze for three seconds, then tears welled in his eyes.
"Rescue... me?!"
"Finally... someone’s come to save me!"
He staggered to his feet, lunging to embrace Daniel.
Daniel sidestepped.
"Enough talk. Let’s move."
Outside the dungeon, the prince gazed at the devastated magical beast settlement, utterly stunned.
"All... all of this... you did?"
"Yes."
"Alone?"
"Yes."
The prince drew a deep breath, looked at Daniel with profound respect, and performed an elaborate noble salute.
"Thank you, sir, for saving my life!"
"I, Alfred, swear that in the future, should duty call, I will risk life and limb without hesitation!"
[Ding! Human Prince Alfred’s favor toward you increased to: Lifeblood Bond]
He then pulled out a yellowed blueprint and presented it with both hands.
"This is a treasure I carry with me, originally intended for my father. I now present it to you, as a token of my gratitude!"
[Obtained: SS-Grade Building Blueprint — Heart of Prosperity]

chapters.title: Chapter 49 -49-Four Gods Bathe Together
paragraphs: [Heart of Prosperity (SS-Grade Guild/Territory Building)]
Effects:
Morale +30 (greatly increases loyalty of territory residents)
Food Production +50%
Soldier Attack Power +15%
Trade Tax Revenue +20%
Probability of attracting wandering people +100%
Construction Requirements: Town-level or higher territory, consumes various resources
Description: A blessed mystical building that brings prosperity to the territory and peace to its people.
Daniel’s eyes lit up as he read the effects.
An SS-grade building blueprint!
For Polaris City, this was a godsend.
Although Polaris City was a basic city, its remote location meant it had been neglected.
The city was in a severe "underfed" state!
Any additions that increase both the soft and hard power of the territory were invaluable.
Without hesitation, Daniel opened the guild warehouse and placed the blueprint inside.
[Ding! You have sold an item to Doom Guild: Heart of Prosperity (SS-grade Building Blueprint), price 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[Item is a special building blueprint. Choose: quantity boost / quality boost]
"Quality boost!"
[Ding! Congratulations! You have obtained: Eternal Prosperity Sanctuary Building Blueprint]
[Eternal Prosperity Sanctuary (Supreme-Grade Territory Building)]
Effects:
Morale +90 (residents extremely loyal, almost impossible to rebel)
Food Production +200%
Soldier Attack Power +50%, Defense +50%
Trade Tax Revenue +100%, chance to attract merchants +300%
Probability of attracting wandering people +500%, chance to attract special talents +200%
All resource production within territory +50%
All building effects within territory +20%
Construction Requirements: Basic city-level or higher territory, requires large amounts of basic materials
Description: A divine monument built during the human race’s golden age. It can turn barren land into a human paradise in a short time.
Daniel exhaled deeply.
This wasn’t just a blueprint—it was a cheat code.
With this, Polaris City would be practically unstoppable in prosperity.
He stored the blueprint away and looked at the prince with satisfaction.
"Your Highness, it’s time to go."
The prince nodded and pulled a scroll from his clothes.
"The magical beast’s spatial barrier has been destroyed. I can return directly to the royal city."
"Sir, we shall meet again!"
A flash of golden light, and the prince disappeared.
[Ding! You have completed the mission: Rescue the Captured Human Prince]
[Mission Rating: SSS (Perfect Rescue, including annihilation of magical beast settlement)]
[Event Points +10,000,000]
[EXP +5,000,000 (overflowed)]
[Gold Coins +200,000]
[Contribution Points +6,000]
Daniel nodded in satisfaction.
Next, it was time to check out that 10-star map!
He took out the Beast God’s Fang and gently crushed it.
A moment later, a golden light enveloped him.
[Ding! You are about to enter the 10-star difficulty map — Snowland Sacred Spring]
[Good Luck!]
A flash of white light.
Daniel opened his eyes to find himself standing on a snow-covered plain.
Fine snowflakes fell, chilling his face.
Underfoot, thick snow crunched with every step.
All around, it was silent except for the whistling wind.
Daniel inhaled deeply.
It was beautiful.
Following the system’s guidance, he made his way toward the center of the snowfield.
After about ten minutes, the scenery opened up.
A frozen lake lay ahead, its surface like a mirror, reflecting the falling snow.
In the center of the lake was a spring about ten meters across, steaming gently, contrasting sharply with the surrounding ice and snow.
This was the Snowland Sacred Spring.
Around the Sacred Spring stood four figures.
Daniel’s pupils constricted.
He cast a reconnaissance spell.
[Angel God · Mikaeron (Projection) · LV52 (Legendary-Grade BOSS)]
Skills: Holy Light Judgement, Angel Descent, Divine Shield, Sword of Judgment...
Description: Projection of the Twelve-Winged Archangel’s will, sacred and inviolable.
[Titan God · Sokar (Projection) · LV55 (Legendary-Grade BOSS)]
Skills: Thunder Strike, Earthquake, Giant’s Roar, Titan Grip...
Description: Projection of the Titan king of gold-grade Titans, possessing world-shattering strength.
[Elven Goddess · Ivy (Projection) · LV50 (Legendary-Grade BOSS)]
Skills: Nature’s Wrath, Life Bloom, Starfall Arrows, Forest Protection...
Description: Guardian deity of the Elves, fully integrated with nature.
[Dwarven God · Brock (Projection) · LV48 (Legendary-Grade BOSS)]
Skills: God of Forging, Earth’s Guard, Lava Eruption, Warhammer Storm...
Description: Legendary king of the Dwarves; his warhammer once crushed a dragon’s skull.
Simultaneously, the four figures all turned to look at the suddenly appearing Daniel, eyes filled with curiosity.
"Hm?"
The Titan God furrowed his brow.
"Why you? What happened to that Beast God fool?"
Daniel said nothing, simply studied them.
[Spectator Mode]
"Holy Shit! Angels! Titans! Elves! Dwarves!"
"These are legendary races?!"
"Angel God is gorgeous! Twelve wings, amazing!"
"The Titan is huge! Must be thirty meters tall!"
"Elven Goddess... holy shit, stunning! That aura!"
"Mom, I think I’m in love!"
"Shut up, they’re virtual projections. I need an Elven companion later, haha!"
"Look, Dwarven God is ugly, long beard, haha!"
"Wait, is Faustus going to bathe with all four legendary-grade beings?!"
One comment sparked a flood of speculation. Attention surged immediately.
"Hahaha the scene is too beautiful!"
"Do you think he’ll run?"
"Run? Impossible! Master Faustus never runs!"
"Will he bow? After all, these are gods!"
"I bet he’ll ignore them and just bathe!"
On the field, the Titan God’s face darkened as Daniel remained silent.
"Insignificant human, I’m speaking to you!"
Daniel finally spoke, calmly.
"Beast God? I already killed it."
The four figures froze.
Then the Titan God burst into laughter.
"Hahahaha! You?
A mere human? Killed the Beast God?"
"Even as a projection, it’s not something an ordinary human should match!"
He leaned down, his enormous eyes fixed on Daniel, full of disdain.
"Human, do you even know what we are?"
"We are gods! Supreme-grade existences who rule this land!"
"You humans are nothing but ants!"
He straightened up and addressed the other three gods.
"This guy must have used some vile trick, or that Beast God fool failed on its own.
Since he’s here, let’s crush him while we’re at it."
"Besides, bathing in the Sacred Spring doesn’t need many people. No objections?"
"No objections..."
The other three gods simultaneously deferred.
Compared with the Beast God’s divine rank, this human was utterly insignificant, unworthy of sharing the Sacred Spring.
The Titan God raised his massive hand, slamming it down toward Daniel.
Boom!
The impact of the palm hitting the snow caused the entire plain to shake violently.

chapters.title: Chapter 50 -50-Killing a God with a Wave of the Hand
paragraphs: "Holy shit! That Titan Giant has no sense of honor—he actually attacked God Faustus!"
"God! Dodge!"
"Oh no... that slap alone could turn him into minced meat!"
"Hehe, finally! I can see Faustus getting smashed to death!"
"Get out of here! Which side are you even on?"
"Mind your own business! I just want to see this hacker get rekt!"
"Identification complete: pure idiot upstairs..."
The dust settled.
Daniel stood ten meters away, completely unharmed.
The Titan God froze for a moment.
"Oh? This little ant of yours is interesting."
He raised his hand again.
But Daniel had already drawn his bow.
Aetherlance!
Two golden spears ripped through the air, piercing the Titan God’s chest in succession.
Boom—Boom—!
HP drained instantly.
The Titan God looked down at the massive hole in his chest, eyes wide with disbelief.
"Th...this...how is this possible..."
Before he could finish, his enormous body crashed to the ground.
[Ding! You have slain Titan God (Phantom) (legendary-grade BOSS)]
[Event Points +95,000,000]
[Gold Coin +10,000]
[Special Item Acquired: Titan Core (legendary-grade)]
The spectator stands fell deathly silent.
Then erupted into chaos.
"Holy shit!!!!"
"Two arrows! Another double-arrow kill!"
"A legendary-grade BOSS with 700,000 HP... killed in two arrows?!"
"Titan God?! Anyone with half a brain knows that’s no easy fight—and it’s just gone?!"
"What did the God just say? He killed the Beast God? It’s true!"
"Of course! You came late and missed the iconic moment when the Beast God was one‐shot!"
"Being eliminated first isn’t all bad—you get a front-row seat to God Faustus’ amazing performance. I’m speechless!"
"Humans are invincible! God Faustus is invincible!"
"Tip him! Tip him to death!"
[Player tipped you 200 Gold Coins]
[Player tipped you 100 Gold Coins]
[Player tipped you 500 Gold Coins]
Daniel ignored the messages and bent down to pick up the Titan Core.
[Titan Core (legendary-grade / special material)]
Effect: When used to train a Titan Warrior, 20% chance to upgrade a normal Titan to Gold-grade, 90% chance to upgrade to Silver-grade.
Description: A core containing the blood essence of the Titan God—every Titan dreams of possessing it.
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
Titan Warrior!
One of the highest-tier troops in the Stellar world!
Without hesitation, he sold the Titan Core to his guild.
[Ding! You sold item: Titan Core (legendary-grade) to Doom Guild for 1 Copper Coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[Since the item is a special material, choose: Quality Boost / Quantity Boost]
"Quality Boost!"
[Ding! Congratulations! You obtained: Primordial Core (supreme-grade)]
[Primordial Core (supreme-grade / special material)]
Effect: Used to train Titan Warriors, 50% chance to upgrade a normal Titan to Primordial Titan, 100% chance to upgrade to Gold-grade Titan!
Primordial Titan: The progenitor bloodline of the Titans, far stronger than ordinary Gold-grade Titans, with partial strength of a creation god.
Description: The heart of the first-generation Titans, containing the purest Titan blood.
Daniel drew a deep breath.
Primordial Titan!
50% chance to upgrade!
100% guaranteed Gold-grade!
Even ignoring the 50% chance, a guaranteed Gold-grade Titan alone is already worthy of vying for the throne!
If he could raise a Gold-grade Titan, the cost-performance ratio would be extraordinary...
He was immersed in this excitement when the system pinged again.
[Ding! Sacred Spring bathing will open in 1 minute. Please prepare.]
Daniel put away the Primordial Core and looked up.
Meanwhile, the remaining three Supreme Beings—Angel God, Elven Goddess, and Dwarven God—stared him down.
Their gazes no longer held disdain, only caution.
"This human... is not normal!"
Dwarven God said gravely, "That Titan was arrogant, but strong. If he could kill him this easily, even as a phantom, it proves he is no ordinary human."
Angel God unfolded twelve wings, holy light coalescing around him.
"Everyone, the Sacred Spring boost favors wolves over meat!"
Elven Goddess nodded, a cold gleam in her eyes.
The elves always loved peace and nature, but ever since humans rose to power, war and plunder became frequent—leaving the elves with a poor impression of humanity.
"Whatever."
"Fine. Then we attack together."
All three moved simultaneously.
Angel God raised his hand; a longsword formed from concentrated holy light, slashing toward Daniel.
Elven Goddess drew her bow, seven star arrows locking onto Daniel’s vital points.
Dwarven God roared, growing in size, swinging his massive war hammer at the ground; a lava fissure spread toward Daniel.
Three legendary-grade beings attacked at once!
The ground quaked with their might.
"Holy shit! Three against one? Are they even gods?!"
"Seriously! Have some shame!"
"God Faustus, run!"
"How do you even block this?!"
"Go, God Faustus!"
Everyone held their breath.
But Daniel’s lips curved slightly.
God Speed!
He vanished instantly, appearing tens of meters away.
The three attacks smashed the ground simultaneously, leaving three massive craters.
Daniel drew his bow.
Shattering Comet! Arrowstorm!
Two skills activated simultaneously.
Meteor fragments carried a golden arrow storm, pouring down upon the three gods.
Boom—Boom—Boom—Boom—Boom!
The deafening explosions subsided.
The three gods stood there, battered and bruised.
Angel God’s holy shield shattered, wings riddled with holes.
Elven Goddess’ star arrows were broken; blood dripped down her arm.
Dwarven God’s war hammer was cracked; half his beard burned off.
Most astonishingly, all three lost roughly a third of their HP!
[Spectator Stand]
"Are my eyes deceiving me? Holy shit!!!"
"Impossible—a single move cripples three legendary-grade gods?!"
"This isn’t human! I’m done!"
"God Faustus is invincible. Ignore those idiots questioning him!"
"No, you guys—those are gods of the major races! This is the critical fight!"
"Terrifying! Truly God Faustus!"
The three gods’ faces turned pale.
"This human... is too strange!"
Elven Goddess gritted her teeth.
"Retreat!!"
She turned and tore through the void, ready to escape.
Daniel’s gaze hardened.
Already attacked, and now you try to run? Too late!
Aetherlance!
Golden spears tore the sky, instantly piercing the Elven Goddess’ back.
Boom—!
HP drained.
Elven Goddess’ body disintegrated into a scattering of light particles.
[Ding! You have slain Elven Goddess (Phantom) (legendary-grade BOSS)]
[Event Points +94,000,000]
[Gold Coin +9,000]
[Skill Book Acquired: Arrow of Nature (S-rank)]
